Green Laser.info:
A large tactical green laser that helps improve gun stability.

20% less gun sway

Engravings.info: Some people call it the gun that won two world wars, however I just think it looks cool... Custom engravings that offer absolutely no tactical advantage, just bragging rights.

infolist:
EXPERIMENTAL! May be scrapped!

Unfolds the bipod from your gun allowing you to mount it on the ground while crouching, prone or near a valid spot! Cannot aim otherwise!
When aimed in, cannot move and slows down unaiming speed but greatly decreases gun kick and improves accuracy!

Traditional Pump.info: Swap your Super Shorty's regular foregrip with a more traditional pump based action. Improves aim speeds, but slightly worsens hipfire and equip speeds.

Yellow Laser.info: A yellow-colored laser with a built-in IR illuminator. Improves weapon equip & unequip speeds, and slightly improves weapon sway.

Ballistics Tracker.info:
A StyLiS-branded phone mount. It's duct-taped to the side of your weapon. Somehow the phone can calculate the perfect position for a headshot.
Unbalances the weapon. Tracks targets within a small radius while aiming. Only you can see the targeting dots.

Unfortunately, the always-on targeting system makes it harder to conceal your own presence: your minimap hide range with suppressors is increased (worsened) by 30 studs, and your minimap pings last 30% longer.

ITHACA Extended Tube.info:
A longer tube for your M37 that holds more shells!
Can hold up to 7 shells at the cost of lower walk speed and slower handling! Also holds less shells in reserve!

U416 Binary.info:
Modify your U-527/22 to fit it with a binary trigger group.
A binary trigger fires one round when you hold down the trigger, but also fires again when you let go!
Increases fire rate but reduces headshot damage.

Glock Switch.info: Replaces parts of your G-Series pistol to allow it to fire fully automatic and become a machine gun by law. However, you cannot stop it from firing

FT300 Wood Furniture.info:
Replaces the standard furniture of your weapon stock for something a bit more classic.
This wood furniture improves a variety of aspects of your weapon to allow it to be best suited for long range engagements.

Blue Laser.info:
A tactical blue laser designed to improve target acquisition speeds.

Improves aiming speed by 7%.

M249 Chainsaw Kit.info:
Special chainsaw kit for the M249 SAW, greatly improving hipfire control, recoil and stability but can make aimed fire more difficult! Also lowers aim walkspeed and handling!
Cannot be combined with grips!

Laser.info:
A red colored laser pointer.
Improves your gun transition speed when you start and stop sprinting.

Target Weight.info: Attach a weight to the front of the GSP's barrel to counter against the rising recoil for better accuracy, but at the cost of general maneuverability.

SL8 Binary.info:
Modify your VG-98 to fit it with a binary trigger group.
A binary trigger fires one round when you hold down the trigger, but also fires again when you let go!

M107 Unfolded Bipod.info:
Unfolds the bipod from your gun allowing you to mount it on the ground while crouching, prone or near a valid spot! Cannot aim otherwise!
When aimed in, cannot move and slows down unaiming speed but greatly decreases gun kick and improves accuracy!

Flashlight.info: A rugged, heavy-duty, high-powered flashlight that lights up dark environments. Don't leave home without one.

Tri Laser.info:
A triple laser pointer.
Improves hipfire damping and decreases your crosshair size & spread rate.

Air Service Mag.info:
Fit your M1903 Springfield with a specialty magazine used in aircraft.
These were used as survival rifles in the instances of soliders becoming stranded after a crash. Very large magazine capacity with the expected downsides...

X95 Armscor Ammo.info: Specialty Armascor 9x19mm ammo stuffed with 3 tiny, buckshot-like, pellets. Splits the stats, and uses a smaller magazine than normal. More powerful than you'd expect, and reloads swiftly.

Rat Shot.info: Pitifully weak multi projectile shell designed to be fired from a .22lr firearm.

Plus P.info:
Overpacked with powder, these rounds aim to make your bullets fly faster, penetrate surfaces better, and increase suppression.
Harder to control.

Volna-R.info: Changes your shot load to Volna-R. Known as 'Wave' in English, fire a single large rubber slug used for less than lethal purposes. But less than lethal is still lethal, and a large 23mm rubber ball is about to prove that with incredibly high damage to the body and limbs, but the actual rubber slug itself travels slowly.

Over Charge (M41A).info: Load your pulse rifle with overcharged ammo!

33rd Mag.info: A factory manufactured extended magazine for the G17 and G18. Guaranteed to make missing slightly less of a problem.

Regular Mag (Type 88).info: Equip the more commonly used 30-round magazine to your Type 88. Less obstructive and more ergonomic for your firearm. Better speed in general, Easier to control recoil.

Minislugs.info:
Changes your shot load to minislugs.
Short, stumpy 1¾ inch shotgun shells that aid in recoil control. Increases capacity if held in a tube by a few shells due to a shorter length. Not as high damage as full size slugs but travels a little faster with faster action and reloading.

.223 Remington.info:
Civilian version of the 5.56x45mm NATO military round.

Reduces recoil at the cost of ranged damage, bullet speed and a little bit of penetration and suppression.
Also slightly boosts aim speed!

Decreases camera recoil.
+2.5% Aiming speed.
-7% Min damage.
-25% Max range.
-8% Penetration and Suppression.

.44 Special.info:
Specialty ammo made for the .44 magnum caliber with the intent of more controllable power.
Less recoil results in greater accuracy, however poorer ranges in exchange for retaining damage.

Exotic Slugs (M79).info:
Changes your shot load to an exotic 12 gauge slug housed in an adapter!
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head.

60rd T20.info: Shove a 60 round drum magazine into your TYPE 20 to help mow down your foes. Drastically affects your weapon handling.

Heavy Can.info: Instead of a regular drink can, load your CAN CANNON with a larger can! This can is taller, making it heavier, it'll travel slower but it'll do a lot more damage. Taste the sand, no matter how coarse it is.

Extended Tube.info: A longer magazine for tube-shotguns, increases magazine capacity with lower overall handling.

M903 SLAP.info:
Nothing can stop you now.
Saboted light armor penetrator rounds made specifically to penetrate as many walls of armor as physically possible. Reduces overall damage, but up bullet speed and penetration.

Flechette.info:
Changes your shot load to flechettes, small dart projectiles specially desgined to defeat soft body armor.
Great for enemies hiding behind cover but less effective against limbs.

SHAK 12.7x55mm DP.info: Swaps your ammunition load to a duplex bullet! Fires two smaller, weaker projectiles that hit hard up close, but lose out on damage and accuracy at range.

22rd Mag.info: A factory manufactured extended magazine for the G23. Guaranteed to make missing slightly less of a problem.

20rd Drum.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold 20 rounds. Slightly reduces spare rounds carried, slightly slower reload speed.

Cannon Ball.info: Instead of a regular drink can, load your CAN CANNON with a literal cannon ball! Armed with a true cannon, become a swashbuckling pirate with this slow but powerful projectile!

.410 Flechette.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 flechettes, six small dart projectiles specially designed to defeat soft body armor.
Great for enemies hiding behind cover.

M60 5.56.info:
A 5.56x45mm NATO conversion kit for the M60 machine gun.

With no military applications and very little civil interest in it, it inevitably faded into obscurity.

But hey - I'm sure you can find a use for it, right? We'll even throw in a new fire selector that allows for semi-automatic and fully-automatic fire, free of charge!

M16A1 M855.info:
Load your M16A1 with green-tipped M855 5.56x45mm ammo.

Later used due to being more favourable than M193, M855 has much greater penetration potential than the M193.

However M855 has erratic performance when fired in the M16A1 as bullets tumble in the air.

VKS 12.7x55mm VPS.info: Load your VKS with 12.7x55mm VPS armor piercing rounds: giving it significantly increased penetration, but halves your limb kill range while also lowering bullet speed and minimum damage due to overpenetration!

.410 Bore.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 buckshot, four average sized pellets that are great for putting down pesky human-sized vermin.
Functions almost identically to the Judge default ammo.

20 Round Type 20.info:
A smaller magazine reducing how much ammo you hold.
But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun!

Timberwolf .338 Norma.info:
Loads your C14 with .338 Norma Magnum.
This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length.
While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it focuses on improving your firing speed!

SHAK 12.7x55mm LP.info: Swaps your ammunition to 12.7x55mm LP supersonic ammo: a lightweight bullet that increases your muzzle velocity significantly while reducing damage. Comes with a 20-round extended magazine for more traditional battle rifle performance.

Birdshot.info:
Changes your shot load to birdshot, small pellets that are great for hunting waterfowl and grouse.
Fires twice the amount of pellets, but each pellet has lower damage potential and is slower. Reduced penetration.

Judge Slugs.info:
Changes your shot load to a slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

26rd Mag.info: A factory manufactured extended magazine for the G21. Guaranteed to make missing slightly less of a problem.

Golf Ball.info: Instead of a regular drink can, load your CAN CANNON with a golf ball! Take to the green and score a hole in one with a higher velocity projectile! It is however weaker in terms of overall damage due to being smaller.

.410 Slugs.info:
Changes your shot load to a .410 slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

Shrapnel-25.info: Changes your shot load to Shrapnel-25. Saboted 23mm shells designed to keep the buckshot close to the center of the barrel making shots at range much easier to hit consistently. Reduces spread dramatically but lowers individual pellet damage.

SCAR SC 300 Subsonic.info: Uses subsonic .300 BLK ammo. Quieter firing sound with the ability to stay completely off the radar when equipped with a suppressor and better ranged and headshot damage at the cost of low bullet speed and range!

Barrikada.info: Changes your shot load to Barrikada. Known as 'Barricade' in English, fire a large solid steel projectile much like a slug with the capabilities of destroying a cars engine block at up to 100 meters. Increased projectile speed with high damage to the head at range. Incredible penetration potential.

.410 Rubber Pellets.info:
Changes your load to .410 rubber pellets, three rubber balls projectiles specially designed to make a target feel stinging pain.
Great for close range encounters but hardly make a difference at long range.

30rd Mag G40.info: A factory manufactured extended magazine for the G40. Guaranteed to make missing slightly less of a problem.

Dust Shot.info:
So instead of using standard .50 BMG rounds, you are using .50 BMG rat shot. Why would you load your rifle with rat shot? What kind of rats are you against?
I don't see really big rats...

Minishell.info:
Changes your shot load to minishells.
Short, stumpy 1¾ inch shotgun shells that aid in recoil control. Increases capacity if held in a tube by a few shells due to a shorter length. Poorer damage due to being filled with #1 buckshot. Tighter spread with faster action and reloading.

410 Beehive (M79).info:
Changes your shot load to .410 bore housed in a four slotted hornet's nest shell (16 pellets).
Less power and ammo, but more range, speed, and pellets per shot.

Super Armor Piercing.info:
For 5.45x39mm firearms.
Changes your ammunition to red tipped super armor piercing rounds.
Damage drops off immediately with vastly increased bullet penetration (+40%) but harshly cuts at long range damage (-10%) and reduces head damage multiplier (-7.5%).

U1 31x71mm Grenades.info:
So you ever notice that underbarrel grenade launcher you have? Well don't question it now, I am letting you use it.

just ignore how buggy the first shell insert is, ok?

Extended Magazine.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

Tennis Balls.info: Instead of a regular drink can, load your CAN CANNON with two tennis balls! Start a ralley and launch two tennis balls which will deal more damage in range! Accounting for how light tennis balls are there may be deviation into if they will hit anyone.

PKM FSDS.info:
Loads your weapon with 10/4.5x54mm FSDS rounds.
It is a dart encased in a sabot allowing it to fly incredibly fast with greater penetration materials while having lighter recoil, but reduces damage significantly.
Greater headshot damage and comes with lighter gun parts for your PK's which improve mobility and handling!
Shots may deviate from the center.

Bloxy Cola.info: Warning: Bloxy Cola may be habit-forming.

MTS-570 Conversion.info:
A conversion for the MTS-569.
Trades off the stopping power of 12.7x55mm for the slightly better ballistics of 9x39mm SP, along with less recoil!
Changes the gun's name to the MTS-570!

12rd MAK.info: Fits your Makarov family pistol with a 12rd magazine. Reduces total spare rounds carried.

Slugs.info:
Changes your shot load to a slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

.45 Special.info:
Modernised version of the .45 ACP cartridge made of stronger brass and filled with more powder. All without changing the original cartridge dimensions.
Increases overall bullet performance, with poorer damage in range. Greater velocity and range.

.17 Wildcat.info:
Why would you do this...?

Wildcat .50 BMG cartridge made to fire a tiny little .17 caliber bullet.
The speed of the bullet is unmatched.

Elite Darts.info: The most dangerous ammunition known to man.

.38 Special.info:
Specialty ammo made for the .357 caliber with the intent of more controllable power.
Less recoil results in greater accuracy, however poorer ranges in exchange for retaining damage.

Type 37 Conversion.info:
Changes the internals of your M3A1 to match the one of its clone, the Type 37.
This clone developed by Jinhan fires 9x19mm. Offering a higher headshot multiplier, more accuracy, more spare ammo and better range performance!
However, your close range damage is reduced!

RSH 12 Gauge.info: Loads your revolver in 28 Gauge shells effectively turning it into a full on shotgun revolver!

Tracerless.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

RSH-9 Conversion.info:
A conversion for the RSH-12.
Trades off the stopping power of 12.7x55mm for the slightly better ballistics of 9x39mm SP, along with less recoil!
Changes the gun's name to the RSH-9!

.375 CheyTac.info:
Load your Intervention with .375 CheyTac.
The alternative ammo that the Intervention can be made to fire featuring faster muzzle velocity but reduced penetration and range.

.223 Remington (Alt).info:
Civilian version of the 5.56x45mm NATO military round mixed with an extended magazine. Typically has less power.
Less recoil for better accuracy for decreased damage and bullet speed mixed with the positives and negatives of an extended magazine.

M17 21rnd.info: Inreases your magsize from 17 to 21. 5% decrease to overall mobility.

AWS Subsonic Ammo.info:
Subsonic 7.62x51mm NATO made specifically for the AWS.

Noise levels are comparable to .22LR match ammunition at the cost of muzzle velocity.

Introduces unique one shot kill ranges with its heavier grain projectile.

Greatly reduces the suppression effect so enemies will not know you are shooting at them.

3½ Shell.info:
Changes your shot load to 3½ inch buckshot shells.
8 pellets of #00 buckshot in a 3½ inch super-duper magnum shell packed to the brim with as much powder as you could possibly want.
Increases velocity making hitting targets in range easier. Yes, it's actually called a super-duper magnum.

Armor Piercing.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

.416 Barrett.info:
Proprietary bottlenecked centrefire rifle cartridge designed in 2005. It is an alternative to the .50 BMG cartidge.
Faster muzzle velocity but reduced range effectiveness.

M110A1 AAP.info:
The XM1158 Advanced Armor Piercing Round is an armor piercing round replacing both the M80A1 and M993 rounds in 2020.
Significantly increases penetration and comes with a 20 round magazine at the cost of lower damage up close and to the torso!
Has typical extended magazine downsides!

Silent.info:
Experimental XM115 made for 7.62x51mm NATO firearms.

Similar functions to a flash hider, reduces sound too.

Bullet speed and suppression reduced. Works great with suppressors!

380 RAMA.info: Switch the ammotype used in your RAMA 1130 into 380 ACP. Stats adjusted to suit the ammo type fired.

SHAK 12.7x55mm BP.info: Load your ShAK-12 with 12.7x55mm BP armor piercing rounds: giving it significantly increased penetration and performance to the torso, but reduced performance to the head.

Buckshot (M79).info:
Changes your shot load to a M576 40mm Buckshot shell, firing 20 destructive pellets from your grenade launcher!
Lower velocity but larger overall damage.

.410 Birdshot.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 birdshot, small pellets that are great for hunting waterfowl and grouse.
Fires twice the amount of pellets, but each pellet has lower damage potential and is slower. Reduced penetration. Wider pellet spread due to wider choke.

#000 Buckshot.info:
Changes your shot load to #000 buckshot, one the largest diameter pellets commercially available, perfect for hunting and for self defence.
Large pellets dealing high damage to enemies, with greater spread and penetration but lower pellet velocity.

KS 4G.info:
An incredibly large shotgun shell typically used for shooting waterfowl or big game in long range. Typically sold in the civilian market. Almost guaranteed to take multiple targets in a single shot!
Contains a large wide-spread amount of pellets with higher penetration with reduced damage, but powerful enough to annihilate anything in your path!
Takes extra time and care to rechamber!

Banana.info: There's always bullets in the banana mag.

Special Alexandrite.info: Uses special Alexandrite inside a .308 casing! This gem magically allows you to alter your gun performance, starting at its normal performance, then flip the switch to make it fire at half the fire rate but significantly improves recoil! Additionally, this gem also boosts your velocity significantly and the thinner nature allows you to carry 50 extra rounds in your box, but it is not so good at suppression!

FALO 50.41 Drum.info: 50rd X-FAL drum magazine! Gives you the true FAL LMG experience by giving you 50 rounds of ammo! But reloads slow and will lower your walkspeed and handling.

Topaz Hunter.info: Uses an energetic Topaz inside a .308 casing! This gem turns your gun into a belt fed DMR, dealing very high damage especially to the torso and head capable of one shotting in the torso up close and a guaranteed kill in the head at any range! Can only carry half the magazine capacity due to the thicker round but this improves overall handling aswell!

BWC9 17rnd.info:
A shorter magazine for the BWC9 with slightly improved handling characteristics and impressive reserve ammo.

How can I hold all of these magazines?

Subsonic Ruby.info: Uses the soft heavy Ruby inside a .308 casing! Due to the softer nature of this gem, your gun is now subsonic and allows it to fire insanely fast! Or can be switched to fire slower for better accuracy! Sound, suppression and radar detection are fully masked and close range damage is increased but at the cost of heavy reduction in velocity and ranged performance!

M60 Depleted Uranium.info:
Load your M60 with 30 rounds of surplus D.U.D.S (Depleted Uranium Discarding Sabots)

Significantly reduced capacity and greatly increased penetration depth. Uranium Fever has done and got me down!

PKP Duplex.info:
Loads your PKP with deadly 7.62x54mmR Duplex rounds.
Fires two bullets that deal significantly higher damage if both hit the same target.
Reduced fire rate due to the lower powder load.
Reduced penetration, suppression and may deviate from the center.

RPK 75rd Drum.info: Replaces your 40rd magazine with a 75rd Drum Magazine! Significantly increases ammo capacity and reserve while also reducing vertical updrift thanks to the weight! Takes a while to reload and weighs down your firearm while also making horizontal recoil slightly less controllable!

10/3.5mm.info:
An obscure Zarovian cartridge that can be loaded in 7.62x54mmR weapons including your SVDS!
It is a dart encased in a sabot allowing it to fly incredibly fast with great potential in penetrating softer materials but not great at shooting limbs due to overpenetration!
Very powerful headshot damage and fast fire rate!

Amethyst Stream.info: Uses pure Amethyst inside a .308 casing! Magically converts your gun into a 10 round burst rapid firing storm gun, but has a lengthy cooldown due to overheating! Comes with 2 extra boxes of ammo!

Emerald Beam.info: Uses small Emerald rocks inside a .308 casing! These fly and accelerate extremely fast and nullifies all recoil to the point your gun is now a hitscan! Alongside that, doubles your magazine capacity with infinite reserve and a faster reload! However these rocks deal very little damage but ramp up a little over range!

Flechette (M79).info:
Changes your shot load to a M1001 40mm high velocity canister cartridge filled with a ton of flechette darts!
Highly effective against body armor and enemies behind cover!

10 Round MP-9.info: A 10 round magazine for your extremely high RPM PDW. Only use if you know what you're doing.

20 Round MP-9.info: A 20 round capacity magazine used on the TEC-9. Improves handling and reload speeds..

MP-9 Drum.info: A large 9mm drum magazine. Massively improves magazine capacity at a significant gun handling penalty.

M60 Assault Box.info:
A smaller 50rd ammo box that also reduces ammo reserve.

Great benefit in movement and handling and a slightly faster reload time.

Slightly increases rising recoil and vertical camera kick.

Scout 5.56 Conversion.info: Load your Scout rifle with .223, a more common civilian ammunition with slightly improved handling characteristics and even more abysmal body damage.

Onyx Shards.info: Uses a large Onyx gem inside a .308 casing! This thick stone breaks off instantly into many shards once fired, these shards are very sharp and pierce through a lot of material dealing high damage! These Onyx bullets are so thick that it requires manual rechambering and limits your box ammo quantity to only 20!

Rare Painite.info: Uses very rare Painite inside a .308 casing! This special gem truly inflicts the PAIN on your enemy by improving weapon performance and damage significantly without any visible drawbacks! However, due to how rare this gem is: you have only been able to bring 1 box of it! So if you run out, the fun is over!

Depleted Uranium.info:
Changes your ammunition to rounds with a depleted uranium core.
Aside from the usual rounds created for 20mm or 30mm guns, small amounts of it were made in .308 Winchester. For some strange reason depleted uranium has the quality of self sharpening when in contact with something. Very high bullet velocity and more penetration than you know what to do with.
Physically cannot work with suppressors.

Sapphire Edge.info: Uses the sharp edges of Sapphire inside a .308 casing! Magically reduces reload time and even more if it's empty while also being semi good at penetration and never loses power over range! However it does deal less damage up close, lower velocity and requires a lower fire rate to fire safely!

Sponge (M79).info:
Changes your shot load to a 40mm Sponge Grenade, a large projectile produced to disable or confuse a single target (for riot control).
Powerful and able to down an opponent instantly at any range but suffers from extremely low muzzle velocity!

Diamond Point.info: Uses very sharp Diamond points inside a .308 casing! These are very powerful at penetrating deep into hard surfaces and dealing massive damage to the body and head but weak against limbs due to overpenetration and requires a lower fire rate to fire safely!

Quartz Storm.info: Uses brittle Quartz inside a .308 casing! Easily breaks off when fired, resulting in 3 pieces flying wild and falls straight down like a brick at range! Very deadly damage up close but falls off hard and is weak at range!

M249 60rd Casket.info:
Loads your M249 SAW with a 60rd STANAG casket magazine, eliminating a lot of reload time and weight!
Large ammo reserve pool, slight decrease in vertical kick at the cost of some left bias kick due to the uneven weight and will take longer to reload when empty!

R10/22 Reduced Magazine.info:
A smaller magazine reducing how much ammo you hold.
But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun!

10 Round GSH-18.info: Swap your magazine for a reduced 10 round capacity magazine! Improves reload speed and handling!

FALO 50.41 20rnd.info:
A smaller magazine reducing how much ammo you hold.
But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun!

Super Armor Piercing PP2000.info:
Changes your ammunition to red tipped super armor piercing rounds.
This cartridge in particular is the 7N31 cartridge, originally designed for use with the GSh-18 pistol. Damage drops off immediately with vastly increased bullet penetration but harshly cuts at suppression and long range damage.

MAC-11 32rd Mag.info: A 32 round magazine for your MAC-11! Increases magazine capacity to 32 at the cost of a longer reload time and slower handling!

SPR Drum Mag.info: 50rd X-FAL drum magazine! Gives you a significant amount of ammo but reloads slow and will lower your walkspeed and handling!

M107 M903 SLAP.info:
Nothing can stop you now.
Saboted light armor penetrator rounds made specifically to penetrate as many walls of armor as physically possible. Reduces overall damage, but up bullet speed and penetration.

FALO 50.41 10rnd.info:
An even smaller magazine reducing how much ammo you hold.
But significantly improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun!
At this point, is this even a LMG anymore?

M249 30rd STANAG.info:
Loads your M249 SAW with a standard 30rd STANAG magazine, sacrificing a lot of ammo for a lot more mobility, faster handling and shorter reload time!
Very large ammo pool, slight decrease in vertical kick at the cost of some left bias kick due to the uneven weight.
Movement and handling is still heavier than a standard assault rifle!

SPR Extended Mag.info:
A 30 round magazine for your FAL! Allowing it to last longer in battle but your reload time will be even longer than it already is!
Lower walkspeed, reserve and handling!

M107 Rat Shot.info:
So instead of using standard .50 BMG rounds, you are using .50 BMG rat shot. Why would you load your rifle with rat shot? What kind of rats are you against?
I don't see really big rats...

M249 200rd Box.info:
A large 200 round box for the M249 SAW, this should let you last for a long while!
Comes at a significant cost of movement speed, handling and reload time due to the weight!

COLT ACR Phase-1 Duplex.info:
Uses experimental Phase-1 Duplex rounds, it's made of a tungsten core which has more penetration than your base ammo, but at the cost of limb and headshot damage, and your bullet speed!
Comes with a 20rd magazine improving your reload, walk and handling speed!

COLT ACR M855.info:
Uses M855 instead of Duplex rounds. More accurate than the base ammo!
Deals good damage to the torso and head, high bullet speed, good penetration and lower recoil but fires slow and not so good at dealing limb damage!

FAL 50 Reduced Magazine.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the FAL, ammo conservation will be even harder but you will get rid of the very harsh downside of the FAL's reload time and some weight improvements.

9mm Major.info:
An extremely high-pressure variant of 9x19mm used in competition shooting.

Higher recoil, velocity, and ranges.

DBP88.info:
A variant of 5.8x42mm designed specifically for squad automatic weapons and designated marksman rifles.

Utilizes a heavy steel core extending your range and penetration at the cost of close range performance, camera recoil control and bullet speed!

SA58 10rd Magazine.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the FAL, ammo conservation will be even harder but you will get rid of the very harsh downside of the FAL's reload time and some weight improvements.

M107 .17 Wildcat.info:
Why would you do this...?

Wildcat .50 BMG cartridge made to fire a tiny little .17 caliber bullet.
The speed of the bullet is unmatched.

M107 .416 Barrett.info:
Proprietary bottlenecked centrefire rifle cartridge designed in 2005. It is an alternative to the .50 BMG cartidge.
Faster muzzle velocity but reduced range effectiveness.

MAC-11 50rd Mag.info: A 32 round magazine for your MAC-11! Increases magazine capacity to 32 at the cost of a longer reload time and slower handling!

M107 Reduced Magazine.info:
A smaller magazine reducing how much ammo you hold.
But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun!

R10/22 Drum Magazine.info:
A 50rd teardrop drum magazine for the R10/22.
Doubles your magazine capacity at the cost of handling & reload speed!

M198 Duplex.info:
Loads your rifle with 7.62x51mm M198 duplex ammunition. Designed to improve hit probability, the ammunition fires two smaller bullets with every pull of the trigger.

Unfortunately, the smaller bullets tumble at longer ranges negating any sort of advantage offered by the additional projectiles.

HB 300 Subsonic.info: Uses subsonic .300 BLK ammo. Quieter firing sound with the ability to stay completely off the radar when equipped with a suppressor and better ranged and headshot/torso damage at the cost of low bullet speed and range!

MP7 DM31.info:
An copped-plated steel armor-piercing round for the X46.
Provides excellent penetrative capabilities, but lacks overall damage.

MP7 5.7x28.info:
A 5.7x28mm conversion for the X46 based off of a civilian X46 clone.
Provides improved damage from the larger round at the cost of increased recoil and a limited magazine size.

SCAR-H 10rd.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the MK17 SOCOM, ammo conservation will be harder in exchange for better reload time and some weight improvements.

RPK-16 60rd.info:
Loads your RPK-16 with a 60rd magazine, eliminating a lot of reload time and weight!
Larger ammo reserve pool, slightly increased handling and mobility speeds but also slightly increased recoil from the reduced weight.

Drum Magazine.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold many more rounds. This heavy magazine greatly reduces spare rounds carried, slows reload and handling speed, and slows your walkspeed, but at least you'll feel like a mobster.

Beta C Drum Mag.info:
A large 100 round Beta-C drum magazine!
Allows you to fire for a long time at the cost of walk walkspeed, your aim, sprint and equip transition speeds and increases reload time significantly!

HK Reduced Mag.info: A smaller magazine that only holds 10 rounds! But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun significantly!

A3M2 223 BTHP.info:
Chambers your UAR A3M2 in .223 Rem BTHP, a hollow point cartridge used for high-precision sport shooting.
Comes with a 10-round magazine offering more mobility, handling and a faster reload while having great damage towards headshots but body damage becomes poor at range.

Ballista 338 Norma.info:
Loads your BALLISTA with .338 Norma Magnum.
This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length.
While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it focuses on improving your firing speed!

Thunder Squeezebore.info: Swaps out your THUNDER's ammunition with squeezebore rounds, giving it multiple projectiles at the cost of accuracy and damage potential at range.

MP7 B2F.info:
A two-part fragmenting bullet designed for the X46, designed to improve damage against soft targets.
Minor spread and deals significantly higher damage if both bullets hit but lower bullet speed and penetration.

Ballista 300 Win Mag.info:
Converts your Ballista to fire .300 Winchester Magnum!
A fast bottlenecked magnum rifle cartridge with great close range damage potentional and high muzzle velocity, but shortens the torso kill range and slows down your cycling rate! Magazine carries up to 10 rounds!

Reduced Magazine.info: Reduced magazine capacity to increase mobility and handling speed.

Ballista 308 Win.info:
Converts your Ballista to fire .308 Winchester!
Faster cycling and an above average magazine capacity of 15 rounds with this lower caliber round but lowers damage and penetration!

Bolo Round.info:
Changes your shot load to a bolo.
Two large lead pellets joined together by a metal cable with incredible penetration potentional designed to rip through bodies.
High damage at range with very low spread but lacks in damage up close!

AK-12M 45rd.info: Loads your AK-12M with a 45rd magazine, increasing magazine capacity at the cost of handling and mobility! Slightly reduced overall ammo storage, but the extra weight reduces some recoil.

5.56x45 Shellshock (MK12).info: An extremely high-pressure 5.56x45mm cartridge made from a nickel alloy, designed to provide nearly 30% additional velocity to the cartridge and improve long-range ballistics. Slightly higher recoil, but better headshot performance.

SCAR SC 5.56.info:
Converts your MK16 SOCOM SC to fire 5.56x45mm NATO!
Lower close up damage, but better ranged damage, bullet speed, hipfire control and much lower recoil!

KS HARPOON.info:
Muzzle load a harpoon into your KS-23M.
 Ignoring the lack of the rope typically attached, this uses an overpressured blank shell to propel the harpoon way over yonder!

IA2 SMG Reduced Mag.info: A smaller magazine that only holds 17 rounds! But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun significantly!

IA2 SMG 40 S&W.info:
Converts your IA2 SMG to fire .40 S&W. Increased damage up close while also increasing penetration and suppression but worse ranged performance and slightly higher recoil!
Smaller magazine capacity but lowers overall gun weight.

30rd STANAG.info: Load your rifle with a shorter 30rd STANAG magazine. Less rounds carried with greater mobility. Slightly more recoil as a result of losing weight on the weapon.

AK-19 6.02mm Mag.info:
Converts your AK-19 to fire 6.02x41mm - a highly experimental round designed in response to the Grand Federation NGSW program and 6.8x51mm ammo.
Intended as a universal replacement for 5.45x39 and 7.62x39, the AK-22 represents a hypothetical universal AK rifle. Very little else is known about the program, and it was likely shelved due to logistical costs.
Improves damage performance and penetration at the cost of recoil control.

SA58 20rd Magazine.info: A smaller 20rd magazine for the SA58 OSW, acts like a typical battle rifle now but should be on the lighter side compared to the FAL 50.00!

COBRAY Bolo Round.info:
Changes your shot load to a bolo.
Two large lead pellets joined together by a metal cable with incredible penetration potentional designed to rip through bodies.
High damage at range with very low spread but lacks in damage up close!

5.56x45 Shellshock.info: An extremely high-pressure 5.56x45mm cartridge made from a nickel alloy, designed to provide nearly 30% additional velocity to the cartridge and improve long-range ballistics. Slightly higher recoil, but better headshot performance.

Rubber Pellets.info: Shotgun shells loaded with rubber buckshot. Less than lethal isn't the same as non-lethal, and you're about to prove that...

Hollow Point.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).

Marble Jar.info:
A masonry jar full with half-inch diameter glass marbles. The shattering glass and the marbles will make for excellent shrapnel against any close range target, however....glass doesn't fly very far, so velocity will drop badly.

Now, eat the forbidden caviar...just don't lose your marbles while doing it, will ya?

BWC9 30rnd.info: Increases your magsize to 30 from 21. 5% decrease to overall mobility.

.45 RUBBER GSH-18.info:
Loads your GSH-18 with .45 Rubber!
Increased damage overall and will always one shot to the head, but extremely poor penetrating power, suppression and velocity!
Requires manual rechambering!

A3M2 300 Subsonic.info: Uses subsonic .300 BLK ammo. Quieter firing sound with the ability to stay completely off the radar when equipped with a suppressor while offering improved damage performance at long ranges at the cost of poor muzzle velocity and reduced penetration!

.22 Super Colibri.info: Loads your .22LR rifle with Super Colibri rounds, which are the closest you'll get to a pellet gun with how pathetic the velocity is.

M107 .50 Cal Drum.info: A 20 round drum magazine for a .50 Cal anti-materiel rifle.

.22 Rat Shot (Ruger).info:
Loads your gun with small .22 Rat Shot bullets, each firing 10 pellets with little spread!
Powerful up close, especially to the head but has very poor muzzle velocity, penetration and ranged performance!

9x18mm 7N25.info:
For 9x18mm firearms.
Changes your ammunition to the 7N25 variant.
Increases torso damage multiplier (+10%) but also significantly increases bullet velocity (+50%) and penetration (+140%) while cutting down overall damage & range (-10%) and head damage multiplier (-7.5%).

Short Barrel Gyrojet.info: Fits your Gyrojet with a shorter barrel, making an already small handheld rocket launcher even smaller. Costing accuracy and a couple thousand dollars.

CheyTac CQB Barrel.info: Shortened homemade barrel modification for the M200 Intervention. Not suited for long range engagements.

Hecate CQB Barrel.info: Shortened barrel for the CQB Variant of the HECATE II. Not suited for long range engagements.

CTAR Barrel.info:
Shortened barrel for the TAR-21, this barrel makes your TAR-21 into the CTAR-21.

This barrel reduces your long range potential that is typical to the TAR-21 to favour close quarters performance.

Extended Barrel.info: Extends the barrel length, providing greater damage over range at the cost of handling.

Police Barrel.info: The perfect barrel fitting for a crime fighting law abiding mercenary ready to bring the long arm of justice to this tainted land.

BFG Carbine Barrel.info:
A shortened barrel that turns your gun into the BFG 50 CARBINE!
This lighter 22 inch barrel increases walk speed and handling speeds at a mild cost of bullet speed and penetration.
Accurate enough to still be useful for sniping!

Integral AK9.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the AK-9 platform.

Improves performance at close range at the cost of ranged performance and velocity. Excellent masking.

1858C Long Barrel.info: Long barrel designed specifically for the 1858 line of revolvers. Increases range and bullet velocity but with worse handling.

NTW Obrez Barrel.info: An even shorter barrel for the NTW-20, made by a deaf gunsmith. Provides an exaggerated version of the short barrel stats, good and bad. You are able to stand while aiming with this equipped.

LUTY Rifled Barrel.info:
Adds rifling to your barrel which entirely eliminates the issue of tumbling bullets.
Cannot be used with muzzle or suppressor attachments.

Taurus Barrel.info:
The Taurus carbine kit barrel placed onto your revovler.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

PPSH-41 Obrez Barrel.info: Completely cut off most of your barrel to form a very homemade looking pistol. Expect close range performance to increase drastically but long range to suffer.

Integral CSMG.info: An integral suppressor for the M635 SMG. Provides excellent radar masking and mild recoil and range bonuses, but has worse handling.

Short Barrel REX.info: Reduce your barrel length to give yourself the legendary MP412 REX. Despite never reaching sales, it has seen the faces of battlefields across the world. You'll never be in bad company with this by your side!

KSG 25 Extension.info:
Lengthened barrel and tube(s) specially designed to make the KSG 25.
Works like a mix of extended tube and the longer barrel.
May impede speed, including aim, reload, and movement...

Long Barrel (Rev).info: Longer barrel design made for revolvers. Better range and accuracy. Worse handling and equip speed. Yee-haw...

Short Barrel (AR).info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

Long Barrel Gyrojet.info:
Extended barrel for extended rocket flinging purposes.
This longer barrel is great for solving the Gyrojets primary issue at the cost of performance.

Long Barrel (PISTOL).info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

Long Barrel (MC51).info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

OSS Suppressor.info:
35 stud detection radius.

Covert Ops suppressor built during WW2 to accommodate the M3 SMG, and adapted for use on the M3A1.
Improved performance at range with decent masking.

Air Service Barrel.info: Barrel used on the Air Service M1903 Springfield rifle. Reduces weapon weight due to the lack of extra parts on the weapon, faster aimspeed.

M10 Carbine Barrel.info: A familiar looking barrel for the Carbine Variant of the MAC-10. Further positives but also negative aspects than the typical long barrel!

Long Barrel (SHOTGUN).info:
Longer barrel best suited for longer range, perfect for sporting purposes.
Better range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

Long Barrel (NTW-20).info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

AK107 BARS Barrel.info: A specialty barrel made with the Balanced Automatics Recoil System in it. It will have drastic effects on recoil and RPM, among other stats.

Tec-9 Long Barrel.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

Integral MC51.info: An integral suppressor for the STG-89C.

Front Post.info:
Attach a front post to your 3-line rifle.
Optional and free!

1858 Long Barrel.info: Long barrel designed specifically for the 1858 line of revolvers. Increases range and bullet velocity but with worse handling.

Short Barrel (PISTOL).info:
Shorter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Greater mid-range performance at the cost of long range performance and penetration. Greater mobility.

Short Barrel (SHOTGUN).info:
A short, cut down barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

SA58 Shorty Barrel.info:
A special aftermarket shorty barrel for your SA58 OSW to turn it into something familiar...
Combined stats of Short Barrel and Romanian Grip!

Snubnose Barrel.info: Shorter barrel design made for revolvers that makes it easier to pull from a holster. Hurts bullet velocity and range.

SCAR SC Integral.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the .300 BLK MK16 SOCOM SC and intended for police usage.
Increases bullet speed, penetration and damage range at the cost of hipfire spread, walkspeed and handling!

Tec-9 Short Barrel.info:
Shorter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Greater mid-range performance at the cost of long range performance and penetration. Greater mobility.

Kek-50 Long Barrel.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

Combat Barrel (DT11).info: A medium length barrel perfect for just about any engagement in normal circumstances. Improves close range performance slightly, speeds reload time and increases spread.

Short Barrel (SNIPER).info:
Lighter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed, mobility and handling. However, the barrel's length will hurt bullet range, penetration, and velocity.

AUG A3 Integral Suppressor.info:
50 stud detection radius.

An integral suppressor designed for the UAR A3.
Increases bullet speed, penetration and damage range at the cost of hipfire spread, walk speed and handling!

Obrez Long Barrel.info: Fit your Obrez with an extended barrel, improving muzzle velocity but affecting other areas of the weapons performance.

Long Barrel (SNIPER).info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close overall handling and movement.

Extended Barrel XIX.info: Extends your Mark XIX Desert Eagles barrel length, providing greater damage over range at the cost of handling.

Lengthened Barrel.info:
Extended barrel for your SAIGA-12.
Better range and bullet speed, but a multitude of stats change to befit any caliber to use in your gun. Worse movement.

AK12 BARS Barrel.info: A specialty barrel made with the Balanced Automatics Recoil System in it. It will have drastic effects on recoil and RPM, among other stats. Three-round burst-fire becomes the main firing option, accuracy greatly improved with the BARS system.

Taurus Barrel (Judge).info:
The Taurus carbine kit barrel placed onto your revolver.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

Sawed Off Barrel.info:
A super short sawed-off barrel for your DT11 shotgun.
Further improves close range performance, reloads are a breeze but spread is massively increased.

AK109 BARS Barrel.info: A specialty barrel made with the Balanced Automatics Recoil System in it. It will have drastic effects on recoil and RPM, among other stats.

Long Barrel (DMR).info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and handling speeds. Worse movement.

Short Barrel (Sweetspot).info:
Lighter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed, mobility and close range performance. However, the barrel's length will hurt bullet penetration and velocity.

Long Barrel (Sweetspot).info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

1858C Short Barrel.info: Shorter length barrel for the 1858 Carbine. Better Handling and movement, but the performance and damage suffers.

Long Barrel (C7).info:
Extended barrel and large hanguard found on the DIEMACO LSW.
Worse mobility with greater recoil control and greatly extended ranges. Slower firerate.

BWC9 ShortBarrel.info: If you ever wanted an even 5 point range drop off and no way to add barrel attachments, you got it. Buffs overall mobility of the BWC9.

AUG A3 CQC Barrel.info:
An intermediate longer barrel for the UAR A3.
Slightly increases range and bullet speed for a slight reduction in handling speeds.
Somewhat acts like a Compensator.

Barrett CQB Barrel.info:
A short CQB barrel for the M82A1M. Not suited for long range engagements.
Lowers maximum and minimum ranges required to torso kill, but also penetration and bullet speed. May not always be 100% accurate!
Improves walk speed and handling significantly!

Shortened Barrel.info:
A short, cut down barrel for your SAIGA-12.
Better aim speed and hipfire control, but a multitude of stats change to befit any caliber to use in your gun.

Long Barrel (AK105).info: Lengthens your barrel to match the one of the AK74M assault rifle! Increases fire rate and favors long range performance over close range by improving muzzle velocity and minimum damage but worsening close up damage!

Integral REX.info: A custom built Monarch barrel for the MP412. Tight tolerances and a near non-existent cylinder gap allows it to be fully suppressed. Dominate the competition and show everyone who is king. Decent masking range at the cost of a significantly reduced velocity.

Timberwolf Suppressor.info:
A military suppressor for the C14 sniper system with a (relatively) compact barrel profile.

Slight increase in maximum torso kill range and lowers recoil at the cost of a mild reduction of penetration and aim walkspeed

Short Barrel (DMR).info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

Long Barrel (AR).info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

Longest REX.info: Sometimes, all you need is a really long barrel. Sadly, y'ain't a ranger, but you do got this on your hip! Reduced muzzle flip with massively increased range so you can clear leather long before your opponent ever can.

ITHACA Trench Barrel.info:
An old trench barrel for your M37.
Increases spread but allows you to slamfire faster than usual! (Press T)
Provided you don't use this to grate cheese, this makes sweeping the trenches all the easier!

Integral T20.info:
An integral suppressor for the Type 20.
Improves close quarters performance while trading off damage in range. Low suppression radius and volume.

MAX-11/15 SD Barrel.info:
20 stud detection radius.

An integrally suppressed barrel based off the CAR-15SD!
Improves close range, hipfire spread and aim walkspeed but reduced ranged performance and bullet speed due to a shorter barrel!

Canted Furro Sight.info:
Adds awn addwitional fuwwwy at 45° on the sidewines suwppowting u in the heat of battwe, weady to hewp when he's needed! OwO

Pwess T to toggwe between optics and these sights.

Canted Animu Sight.info:
Adds an additional Anti at 45° on the sidelines supporting you in the heat of battle, ready to help when she's needed!

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

Canted Iron Sight.info:
Adds an additional set of iron sights at 45°, allowing users to quickly switch from a high powered optic to iron sights for favorable performance in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

Canted Delta Sight.info:
Adds an additional delta sight at 45° for fast and clean target acquisition in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

Canted Acog Scope.info:
Adds an additional Acog scope at 45° for those moments you really just need a second scope.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

AWS 9mm Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your AWS 1911 into 9x19mm.
A weaker but much more accurate round fired faster than you could imagine!
Comes in a 20 round magazine, and an extra spare mag!

103 5.56 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your AK-103 into 6.5mm Grendel.

Improves recoil, velocity, and penetration characteristics but has somewhat worse body damage.

AR 20 Tact Conversion.info:
Load your Diemaco rifle with .20 Tactical.
Uses the classic 20-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. But you'll be punished if shots are missed.

K1A 7.62x39 Conversion.info:
Loads your K1A with 7.62x39mm.
Compared to the DR-300, this is a modification to your K1A which through some clever machining, makes it the MAX-III, allowing it to feed the same 7.62x39 magazines coming with the same flaws as the DR-300 in its design.

S-12 762 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12 with 7.62x39mm.
 Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

AutoMag .45 WinMag Conversion.info:
Load your AutoMag with .45 Winchester Magnum.
This makes your AutoMag III into the .45 caliber AutoMag IV. A more traditionally performing handgun cartridge with a lot of power still by comparison.

376 SCOUT.info: Change the ammunition fired from your Scout rifle into 9.5x59mmRB for big game hunting. This larger bore round is much more potent in closer engagements, and increases muzzle velocity. However, magazine capacity is severely reduced and rounds must be reloaded manually.

S-12 Full-Auto Conversion.info:
Change the internals of your Saiga-12 to make it able to fire in full automatic!
Extremely fast fire rate but hard to control!
Loses out on accuracy and damage range.

Mosin 8mm Conversion.info: A rare Stalowan / Alpenstahlan conversion that allows your Mosin-Nagant to fire the larger 8x50mmR Mannlicher cartridge, increasing the power enough to stop a man up to a decently far range. But the cartridge faults allow it to not keep standard sniper rifle traits too well.

K2 7.62x39 Conversion.info:
Loads your K2 with 7.62x39mm.
This turns your K2 into the rare civillian DR-300. This civilian rifle never really took off during its time, with faults being due to the cartridge it fires.

Gyrojet 12mm Rockets.info:
12mm Rockets introduced with the Gyrojet Mark II.
This makes your Gyrojet load a newer, smaller .49 caliber rocket. These rockets will fly faster at the cost of a longer activation range. Higher firerate.

Bren 2 7.62x39mm.info:
Converts your VZ.806 to fire 7.62x39mm!
Overall large increase in damage, penetration and suppression but at the cost of your fire rate, bullet speed and recoil!

.17 HMR Blanks.info:
Challenge Mode Unlocked!
Extremely low caliber blanks with pitiful performance, but better handling!
Good luck!

S-12 308 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12 with .308 Winchester.
 Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

BREN .300 Conversion.info:
Loads your VZ.808 with supersonic .300 AAC Blackout!
Improves close range damage and penetration for reduced damage ranges, muzzle velocity and slightly increased recoil!
Great with suppressors!

S-12 953 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12 with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

1858C Snake Shot.info: Changes your shot load into a special purpose pellet-loaded 44 magnum round. Six almost buckshot sized pellets that are great for putting pesky soldier vermin.

TRG 260.info: A conversion kit to transform your gun into the TRG-22, firing the .260 Remington cartridge. Less power, more maneuverability. Comes with a brand new bolt to make cycling much easier!

S-12 50 Conversion.info:
Load your Saiga-12 with .50 BMG.
 Adjusted performance fitting for th- wait why are you doing this? Like, I get you changed the barrel and everything but... Either way, eat your heart out, AK Guy!

FIVE-0 9mm Conversion.info: Convert your FIVE-0 into firing 9x19mm, greatly increases your magazine capacity at the cost of close range effectiveness. Also increases rate of fire.

Henry 410 Conversion.info:
Converts your Henry 45-70 into the Henry 410, firing .410 bore.
Immense power in close range and good accuracy, but faulters strongly at range.

MUZI Strike-3.info:
Specially made 9x19mm shells loaded with three #1 buckshot pellets. Never made it past experimental stages... Until now.
If you're looking for a bullet hose, this is the ammo type for you.

SVK12E 7.62 Conversion.info:
A rechambering of the SVK-12 for 7.62x51mm NATO, intended for the export market. The SVK-12E foregos the trigger group of the 7.62x54mmR variant for a unique 2-round burst only trigger designed to improve shot accuracy at mid-range through volume of fire. It is dubiously effective.

Somewhat reduced damage, but overall improved recoil control..

TFIX 308.info: Swap your caliber over to .308 Win. Increases magazine capacity, velocity, and treats your rifle closer to a standard light sniper.

.22 Win Magnum (Ruger).info: Loads your .22LR rifle with higher-power magnum rounds, improving performance against the body while reducing it against the head.

AN 7.62x39 Conversion.info: Changes the ammotype fired to 7.62x39mm. Based on the prototyping / dummy model of the AN94 that theoretically fired 7.62x39mm. Expect AK-like traits such more power and recoil.

AWM .308 Conversion.info: Changes the ammunition fired from your AWM into .308 Winchester effectively changing it into the AWP! A much lighter but still deadly ammo type still capable of an one shot limb kill but much shorter. Improves handling, recoil, firing speed and doubles your ammo capacity! Perfect to counter terrorism!

SA80 .22 LR.info: Somehow, a great evil has returned. An esoteric conversion for the SA80 weapons. It trades away damage in exchange for much more manageable recoil and extra handling speed. Aim for headshots and it will be like you have unlimited power.

FT300 7.5.info:
Load your FT300 with the 7.5x55mm Swiss cartridge.
A heavier cartridge doing greater damage across range to an enemies torso, but travels slower with a slower reload. Higher penetration.

Timberwolf .408.info:
A .408 Chey Tac conversion kit for the Timberwolf rifle.
Possesses much higher damage and penetrative power, but comes at the cost of being more cumbersome to use.

MUZI 45 ACP.info: Convert your Micro Uzi into the civilian variant that fires .45 ACP in semi auto with stats to match the change.

S-12U 762 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12U with 7.62x39mm
 Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

AUG .22 LR Conversion.info:
Convert your UAR HEAVY into .22 Long Rifle.
I heard you wanted even less recoil. So this Nomensland variant of the UAR made specially for training helps give you that true 'No Recoil' feel! But the damage to fit the caliber.

ECR 410.info: Convert your ECR to fire .410 bore, housing a 15 round magazine and strong firepower. Doesn't do well at range and struggles with maneuverability.

SVDS 953 Conversion.info:
Load your SVDS with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
 A large Zarovian caliber designed for the general public. Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

NTW 20 Conversion.info:
Load your NTW-20 with 20x110mm Hispano-Suiza.

Improves muzzle velocity and damage per shot, but reduces overall penetration.

AKU 9mm Conversion.info:
A speculative 9x19mm kit for the AK-12 platform, likely intended for the export market to law enforcement.

Low damage, low recoil, excellent handling.

SKORP Rat Shot.info: Load your Skorpion with .32 ACP Ratshot. Make those shots count; with a small magazine size, Ratshot is very effective at close range but is extremely ineffective at longer ranges.

MP5K 10mm Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your SMX-9K into 10mm Auto, effectively making it the ''SMX-9/10''.
Stats adjusted accordingly to the caliber being fired, can you handle the bull?.

X95R .300 Conversion.info:
Convert your X95R to fire .300 AAC Blackout.
Adjusts performance of the firearm.

7.5x55mm Swiss (WA2K).info: A cartridge introduced in 1898, originating from the 7.5x53.5mm cartridge. Allows the WA2000 to perform better at range, penetration and fire rate at the cost of velocity and a shortened torso kill!

AK12 9x39 Conversion.info:
Converts your AK-9 to fire the more traditional 7.62x39mm cartridge, turning it into the AK-12 7.62mm prototype carbine.
Increases muzzle velocity and magazine capacity, while overall reducing damage and penetration slightly.

FT300 6XC.info:
Load your FT300 with the 6XC wildcat cartridge.
Offering poorer close range performance to the .243 winchester cartridge, but it is preferred for long range usage with its slightly improved velocity and ranges due to weight and a faster reload and action time. Small increase to penetration.

VSS 762 Conv.info:
Changes the ammotype fired from your VSS VINTOREZ to 7.62x39mm.
This retools your weapon to be a lot like the civilian model produced by Molot Arms, that suppressor is not doing anything, bucko.

Uzi .45 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .45 ACP.
Improve damage performance but makes the recoil harder to control. Lowered RPM.
Conversion kit by Vector Arms allows the UZI to use M3A1 magazines!

NTW 14.5 Conversion.info:
Load your NTW-20 with 14.5x114mm.
 This turns the weapon into the  NTW-14.5, Keeping the 3 round magazine and giving more optimal sniper rifle performance.

G36K .300 Conversion.info:
Load your STG-91K with .300 Blackout.
Making it the civilian variant with a full-semi trigger group, offering poorer close range close range, but greater long range performance. Great with suppressors!

VPO .366 (Buckshot).info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM (Buckshot).
By Zarovian law this makes your gun a shotgun because of the smoothbore barrel.

Obrez 8mm Conversion.info: A rare Stalowan / Alpenstahlan conversion that makes your Obrez Pistol fire the larger 8x50mmR cartridge, increasing the power enough to stop a man up to a certain range. It does not perform as well at range, among other faults of the cartridge...

GB 10mm Conversion.info:
Load your GB-22 with 10mm Auto.
 This makes it a GB-10, the larger bullet brings greater damage, but worse recoil and less ammunition carried. Great velocity.

AKM .366 (Slugs).info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM ammunition.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are soft point rounds.

RM277 8.6BLK Conversion.info:
Converts your RM 277 to fire the subsonic 8.6mm Blackout cartridge!
This quieter cartridge fully hides you from the radar while increasing your ranged damage!
Very low bullet speed with weaker damage up close while also reducing penetration and firerate somewhat.

SCAR PDW 7.62 Conversion.info:
Swaps your MK16 SOCOM CQB receiver for the one of the MK17 SOCOM, effectively making it a MK17 PDW!

Very high damage - especially in close range - but suffers somewhat from the reduced magazine capacity of 10 and relatively unstable recoil.

e Shotgun Heavy Discs.info: Improves the spread with heavier 'pancakes', with stronger suppression. Range is more evenly spread. Bullets drop faster.

AEK 556 Conversion.info:
Converts your AEK-971 to fire 5.56x45mm turning it into the AEK-972!
Improved range damage while slightly lowering accuracy and damage up close.

S-12U 953 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12U with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
 Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

DBV .410 Conversion.info:
A conversion kit for the .410 shotgun round using a modified trigger group designed to fire in two-round bursts.

Reduced pellet count, but with increased damage per pellet, magazine capacity, and overall rate of fire.

FBI 10 TOMMY.info:
Change the internals of your Thompson with those of the specialized FBI variant that fired 10mm Auto.
Turn the criminal's own weapon against them, with rounds kick like a mule!

PARA 5.56 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into 5.56x45mm NATO.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.
Comes Packed with standard issue 30-round STANAG Magazinse.

105 5.56 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your AK105 into 5.56x45mm NATO using a slightly modified 35-round magazine.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.

ECR 5.56 Conversion.info:
The most common ammo type found in the warzone. Why you're putting it in a rifle designed for 12.7x42mm is beyond mortal understanding.
Expect unforeseen consequences...

S-12U 223 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12U with .223 Remington.
 Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

BIZON 7.62 Conversion.info:
Loads your PP-19 BIZON with 7.62x25mm.
 Smaller magazine, but more power and more motherland!

Redhawk 45 Colt.info: Convert your Redhawk 44 into a Redhawk 45, making it fire the 45 colt cartridge in single action! It will become much stronger in close range, but be slower and hampered at longer ranges.

SCAR PDW 9mm Conversion.info:
Converts your MK16 SOCOM CQB into a true PDW by letting it fire 9x19mm using a conversion kit by Big Woods MFG.
Higher fire rate, close up damage and lower recoil, but lowers ranged damage, penetration and bullet speed.
Retains light weight and quick reload speed!

TCR 5.56 Conversion.info:
The most common ammo type found in the warzone. Why you're putting it in a rifle designed for 12.7x42mm is beyond mortal understanding.
Perfect for getting that civilian firearm feeling!

MOSIN 410.info:
You won't believe what Zarovian farmers are doing this time!
Convert your worn out MOSIN MAGANT into a modern day FROLOVKA that fires 410 bore rounds!

KOV 7.62 Conversion.info:
Load your Krinkov with 7.62x39mm.
 Expect the damage of your firearm to improve greatly with a little added range too. Controlling it might be a problem.

AR 7.62x39 Conversion.info: A high-precision rifle round designed to give the AR-15 platform performance somewhat comparable to 7.62x51mm, but with around half of the recoil impulse. The larger bullet is still able to load into the AR-15's magazines, but with a lower maximum capacity.

AUG 9MM Conversion.info:
Converts your UAR A1 into the F88T training rifle using .22 LR!
Low damage to non-headshots while significantly lowering recoil, reload time and quicker handling.

S-12 9MM Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12 with 9x19mm.
Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

G36 .300 Conversion.info:
Load your STG-91 with .300 Blackout.
Making it the civilian variant with a full-semi trigger group. It offers greater close range performance, worse long range. Great with suppressors!

FAL .45 Conversion.info:
Converts your FAL 50.00 to fire .45 ACP from an aftermarket modified Thompson 50 round drum magazine!
Slow bullet speed and fast range dropoff, but powerful up close and surprisingly still deals decent ranged damage. Slower reload time and handling!

G3 .45 ACP Conversion.info:
Convert your STG-59H into .45 Super.
Changing the weapon to feed from Thompson magazines this conversion can also function with the CETME Model 58 due to it and the STG-59H's similarities. Feels like using a full size battle rifle, but in a PDW-type package.

7.62x39 Blanks.info: Instead of regular 5.56x45mm blanks, load your AR-15 magazine with 7.62x39mm blank rounds! These being larger cartridges means you will propel your projectile further than 5.56x45mm, you also get greater ranges. However, there is the smaller magazine to tend to.

Groza 5.45 Conversion.info: A experimental conversion kit for the OTs-14 'Groza' that allows it to chamber and fire 5.45x39mm. It was never adopted simply because it was redundant compared to 7.62x39mm performance out of a shorter barrel. Average range performance and comes with a 45rd magazine!

ECR .458 Conversion.info:
Loads your ECR with .458 SOCOM.
Lower damage, but significantly improved recoil and magazine capacity.

Uzi .22LR Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .22 Long Rifle.
Stats similar to the ZIP22... But in full auto! Why would you do this?
Comes with a specially made 50 round Promag!

FT300 22LR.info:
Load your FT300 with the .22 Long Rifle cartridge.
This ammo type deals poorer damage in long range to the body and limbs, but still competes due to a fast reload and surprisingly high torso damage. Does not pair with the Marksman Kit and will always single load ammunition. No reserve ammo.

AKM .366 (Buckshot).info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are rounds with small pellets inside of them.

Henry 30-30 Conversion.info:
Converts your Henry 45-70 into the Henry 30-30, firing .30-30 Winchester.
Holds an extra round of ammunition with more accuracy, but less performance in some areas. Faster action.

M855 Specialty Conversion.info:
Load your M231 with M855 5.56x45mm NATO.
 housed in a modified 100-round Beta-C double drum. They tumble quickly after leaving the barrel, causing inaccuracies when firing. An aura of sadness surrounds this conversion. It's as if a fallen hero once wielded this weapon...

HAMR 6.8SPC Conversion.info: Change the ammunition fired from your HAMR IAR to 6.8x43mm SPC. Improved damage output at the cost of recoil control.

FT300 Extended Magazine.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold 10 rounds combined with a straight pull bolt, but lessen certain mobility traits.

CMARS 9x30 Conversion.info:
Load your MARS with 9x30mm MARS, a cartridge made from a necked down 10mm Magnum round.

Possesses high stopping power up close, but falls off at longer ranges.

Vector 357 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your Vector into .357 SIG.
I hope you weren't expecting an easy ride with this conversion...

VPO .366 (Slugs).info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are rounds with small pellets inside of them.

AUG 40 S&W Conversion.info:
Converts your UAR A3 PARA into the AUG 40 firing the .40 S&W cartridge.
Lower fire rate while increasing CQC damage, range and penetration but has a weaker ranged damage and bullet speed.

S-12U 9MM Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12U with 9x19mm.
Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

SVU 953 Conversion.info:
Load your SVU with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
 A much large Zarovian caliber designed for the general public. Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

SCAR-H 7.62 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your MK17 SOCOM into 6.5 Creedmoor.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.

.223 Blanks.info: Instead of regular 5.56x45mm blanks, load your AR-15 magazine with .223 Remington blank rounds! These being weaker cartridges will hurt your projecticles range performance, hurting velocity and damage ranges. But fret not! For you have a 50 round drum!

HAMR 9mm Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your HAMR IAR into 9x19mm using a conversion kit by Big Woods MFG.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.

556 STG.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your STG into 5.56x45mm NATO making it the ''STG-N'' with a 60 round casket magazine.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.
You have defiled history.

1858 Snake Shot.info: Changes your shot load into a special purpose pellet-loaded 357 magnum round. Six almost buckshot sized pellets that are great for putting pesky soldier vermin.

GSP 32 S&W.info: Convert your GSP into the GSP-C, firing the .32 S&W Long round. It is perfect for those who can't seem to land headshots.

e Shotgun Light Discs.info: Lightweight 'pancakes' that improve the bullet speed but decrease accuracy, supppresion, and increases spread.

BIZON 9x18mm Conversion.info:
Loads your PP-19 BIZON with 9x18mm Makarov.
 Larger magazine and less recoil, but slower and less damaging bullets. Not optimal for ranged encounters.

K7 5.56x45 Conversion.info:
Load your K7 with 5.56x45mm NATO.
With some expert gunsmithing you managed to successfully change the round of which your K7 fires to be of the more common 5.56x45mm NATO. Giving performance which fits more a carbine, but is louder due to the nature of this cartridge not being subsonic.

MCX Spear 6.5 Creedmoor.info: Converts your weapon to fire 6.5mm Creedmoor. Uses a 25rd magazine and improves recoil but lowers overall damage and penetration performance!

Henry Big Boy Conversion.info:
Load your Henry 45-70 with .357 Magnum, making it the Henry Big Boy.
Bring back nostalgia of an era you were not even born in.

MP5 .40 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your SMX-9/10 into .40 Smith & Wesson.
Less recoil for better accuracy for decreased close range damage and bullet speed, long range damage is preserved.

P.A.W.S. 45 Conversion.info:
Load your L2A3 with .45 ACP.
This is less a Sterling L2A3, and more of its own thing. The Police Automatic Weapons System ZX-7 was the result of a wish to import the Soveran L2A3 into the Grand Federation. More power in close range with more felt recoil.

USAS-12 Semi Conversion.info:
Change the internals of your USAS-12 to make it able to fire in semi-automatic like the closed-bolt civilian variant.
Better choke accuracy, but less firerate. Can carry an extra round in the chamber.

X95 5.56x30 Conversion.info: An experimental version of the X95 chambered in 5.56x30mm MINSAS for the Sindhara Army. It was ultimately cancelled, but that doesn't stop you! Reduces close range damage while massively boosting muzzle velocity and damage at range.

TRG 375.info: A conversion kit that transforms the gun into the TRG-S, firing the famed .30-06 cartridge. Trades performance at range for a significantly long one-shot kill to any part of the body.

.50 Beowulf Blanks.info: Instead of regular 5.56x45mm blanks, load your AR-15 magazine with custom 12.7x42mm blanks! Despite your small reserve pool, you get a large boost to your range potential with poorer velocity and close range performance.

X95R 5.56 Conversion.info:
Convert your X95R to fire 5.56x45mm NATO.
Adjusts performance of the firearm.

S-12U 50 Conversion.info:
Load your Saiga-12U with .50 BMG.
 Adjusted performance fitting for th- ok, there is no way you're going to get anything working this way...

M3822 Dart Conversion.info: Load your AF2011-A1 into two barrel loaded darts. Deals more damage, but with worse recoil, low bullet velocity and less ammunition carried.

PARA .45 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into .45 ACP.
Heavily modifies performance befitting of the pistol caliber it is firing.
Comes Packed with an aftermarket modified Thompson 50-round drum.

Beowulf .458 Conversion.info:
Loads your Neowulf TCR rifle with .458 SOCOM.

Lowers recoil and increases velocity at the cost of performance, but also doubles your magazine capacity.

M45A1 Dart Conversion.info: Change the ammunition fired from your M45A1 into a single dart. Deals more damage, but with worse recoil, low bullet velocity and less ammunition carried.

SL-8 .300 Conversion.info:
Load your VG-98 with .300 Whisper.
 Effectively making it an VG-98S, a specially designed round made to fire at subsonic sound levels. It is a very big bullet that works very well with suppressors!

.36 Caliber NA.info:
A conversion for 1858 model revolvers.
A smaller caliber meaning it will not deal as great of damage, but has faster firerate and velocity.

S-12U 308 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12U with .308 Winchester.
Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

G36C .300 Conversion.info:
Load your STG-91C with .300 Blackout.
Making it the civilian variant with a full-semi trigger group. It offers greater close range performance, worse long range. Great with suppressors!

MG36 .300 Conversion.info:
Load your MG91 with .300 Blackout.
Making it the civilian variant with a full-semi trigger group, it offers greater close range performance, worse long range. Great with suppressors!

7.62 Conversion (Type 88).info: Retool your TYPE 88 into the TYPE 58, a 7.62x39mm rifle adopted by Hwanmok in 1958 using a 30 round magazine. A lot more power thanks to the new cartridge, however a lot less recoil control.

KOV 9mm Conversion.info:
Load your Krinkov with 9x19mm.
 It uses a specialty magwell adapter so it can accept SMX-9 styled magazines.
Now it can be a 'true pdw' (even though it already was before)!

TFIX 65Cree.info: Swap your caliber over to 6.5 Creedmoor. Faster projectile velocity and improved performance at longer range.

MSG90 308 Conversion.info:
Load your JG-90 with .308 Winchester.
Giving a familiar 10 round magazine, Your JG-90 now has the benefits of the .308 cartridge which include faster velocities and the ability to kill to the head. Alongside being a whole lot lighter.

Pedersen Device.info:
The M1918 Pedersen Device was an experimental conversion for the M1903 firing the .30-18 Auto cartridge. Replacing a majority of your M1903 Springfields parts to allow it to fire in semi-automatic. Feeds from a large 40 round magazine.

Incompatible with the Marksman Kit.

.36 Caliber C.info:
A conversion for 1858 model revolvers.
A smaller caliber meaning it will not deal as great of damage, but has faster firerate and velocity.

Colt LMG 25-45 Conversion.info:
Loads your LSV M/04 with .20 Tactical.
This uses the typical 30-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. Decreases reload time, but you'll be punished even more if shots are missed.

SCAR SC 9mm Conversion.info:
Converts your MK16 SOCOM SC to fire 9x19mm using a conversion kit.
Uses a 50rd drum magazine.
Focusses on CQC by increasing the fire rate, close range damage and reducing the recoil but at the cost of ranged damage, bullet speed and penetration!

GB .50 AE Conversion.info:
Load your GB-22 with .50 AE.
 This makes it a GB-50. The larger bullet brings greater damage, but worse recoil and less ammunition carried.

DBV 30-06 Conversion.info:
A 30-06 conversion kit for the AK-12/76, with a rifled barrel and bolt capable of handling the new round. A popular sporting cartridge, the 30-06 round packs a powerful punch at all ranges.

Very high damage with a below average rate of fire.

AUG A3 7.62x39 Conversion.info:
Converts your UAR A3 to fire 7.62x39mm.
Increases damage and penetration at the cost of high recoil, lower bullet speed and a slower reload time.

Vector .22LR Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your Vector into .22 Long Rifle.
Kills overall performance, but is really nasty with headshots and aiming is a little faster.
Comes with a 20 round magazine. Reloading this thing will be a breeze!

AUG A2 7.62x39 Conversion.info:
Loads your F90 MBR with .224 Valkyrie.
Uses special 25rd magazines made for the Valkyrie cartridge.
Significantly increases ranged bullet performance both in damage and velocity but less powerful towards limb damage up close and increases recoil.

FT300 308.info:
Load your FT300 with the .308 Winchester cartridge.
A heavier cartridge than .243 Winchester with a slightly lower velocity. More power with improved performance in long range, good if you want something between power for close range engagements and velocity for longer range engagements.

OBREZ 410.info:
You won't believe what Zarovian farmers are doing this time!
Convert your worn out MOSIN MAGANT (OBREZ) into a modern day FROLOVKA OBREZ that fires 410 bore rounds!

M1911 .22LR Conversion.info:
