Change the ammunition fired from your M1911 into .22 Rat Shot.
Why would you do this to yourself? Basically you have a mini shotgun...

S-12 223 Conversion.info:
Load your SAIGA-12 with .223 Remington.
Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

HK337 .300 Conversion.info:
Converts your M416 to fire 6.8x43mm SPC!The 6.8mm Special Purpose Cartridge is an intermediate rifle cartridge developed to possibly replace 5.56x45mm.
While it offered superior lethality up close with minimal loss of magazine capacity and negligible increase in recoil, it began to falter at longer ranges and was dropped due to logistical and cost issues.

SHORTY 5.56 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into 5.56x45mm NATO.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.
Comes Packed with standard issue 30-round STANAG Magazinse.

GB 12G Conversion.info:
Somehow load your GB-22 with 12 gauge minishells.
 This makes it a GB-12.
More pellets for greater damage, but horrid muzzle velcoity and less ammunition carried.

Vector 9mm Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your Vector into 9x19mm.
Bigger mag with slightly less recoil, but at the cost of damage, velocity, and a bit of range!.

Remington 700 .32 ACP Adapter.info:
Not you again!
Simple metal adapters allow the use of 7.65mm rounds without any major modifications.
Vastly improved weapon speed, including action and reloading with poor damage and velocity as a tradeoff because your absolute priority is speed.

.300 Win-Magnum (WA2K).info:
A large cartridge introduced by the Winchester Repeating Arms Company in 1933.
Significantly powers up your WA2000 at the cost of ammo capacity and significantly higher recoil!

e Shotgun Penny Conversion.info: Instead of large discs you loaded the magazine with pennies. That's one way to spend your money... your reserve ammo now equates to about 3 dollars.

USC 40 Conversion.info:
Changes the ammunition fired from your PDC-45 with .40 S&W.
Allows for a lethal one shot to the head at close range. Increases fire rate, bullet speed and lowers recoil at the cost of general body damage and range.

SCAR-H 6.8 SPC Conversion.info:
Converts your MK17 SOCOM to fire 6.8x43mm SPC using a MK16 lower receiver!
It was experimented by the Grand Federation back around 2011 with limited examples.
Offers above-average assault rifle performance with a standard 30rd magazine capacity and similar fire rate to the MK16 SOCOM!

FIVE-0 45ACP Conversion.info: Convert your FIVE-0 into firing .45 ACP, increasing magazine capacity at the cost of close up damage. Slight rate of fire increase.

SVK12E 12.7 Conversion.info:
A rechambering of the SVK-12 for the relatively uncommon 12.7x55mm ammo type, typically used by special forces and police units for higher stopping power. Like many of the other AK-12 prototype variants, no real credible info exists on the development of this rifle in this chambering.

Very high damage with somewhat low muzzle velocity..

SKORP Rubber Bullets.info:
Load your Skorpion with .32 ACP Rubber Bullets.
Ammunition usually used by police in riot control. Improved damage to the body which falls off tremendously fast.

FAL 5.56 Conversion.info:
Converts your FAL 50.00 to fire 5.56x45mm NATO.
Feeds from 30rd STANAG magazines. Significantly improves recoil while keeping a strong damage profile with high bullet speed but will still reload slower than your average assault rifle!

SPR .308 Conv.info:
Uses .308 Winchester, a stronger round with higher bullet speed, penetration, improved damage ranges and better head/torso damage!
Slight increase in camera recoil but also exclusively uses 10 round magazines, you will however get better walk speed, handling and a faster reload!

M1911 Dart Conversion.info: Change the ammunition fired from your M1911 into a single dart. Deals more damage, but with worse recoil, low bullet velocity and less ammunition carried.

Deagle 44 357.info:
Load your Desert Eagle L5 with .357 Magnum.
This ammunition makes your weapon more easier to control in exchange for less damage, but you gain better accuracy and reload speed.

Uzi .41 Conversion.info:
Locks to Semi-Auto.
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .41 Action Express in a custom 20 round magazine. Perfect for seige missions.
Use this ammo to punch through cover, and land harder hits to take down the opposition.

Groza 5.56 Conversion.info: A experimental conversion kit for the OTs-14 'Groza' that allows it to chamber and fire 5.56x45mm NATO. It never went into production due to project funding issues. Improves weapon accuracy drastically but reduces overall damage and range.

CS/LR-4A .308 Winchester.info: Rechambers your Jinhanian sniper rifle in .308 Winchester, increasing damage range, bullet speed and penetration but also recoil and cuts down your reserves. Slower cycling rate!

G28 308 Conversion.info: Load your M28 with .308 Winchester, turning it into the civilian M28Z model. Uses a lower-capacity magazine but packs a stronger punch while improving overall handling somewhat.

Mac10 9mm Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your MAC-10 into 9x19mm!
Shoots significantly faster. Reduces recoil and improves bullet speed but weaker damage!

MCX Spear 7.62x51.info: Converts the MCX SPEAR into firing traditional 7.62x51mm NATO. Increases overall damage to perform like a true battle rifle but lowers fire rate, bullet speed and penetration due to the slower bullet!

UMP .40 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your PDX-45 into the PDX-40.
Stats adjusted accordingly to the caliber being fired.

Saiga 220 Russian Conversion.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 5.6x39mm, a 5.6mm projectile from necked down 7.62x39mm brass!
Excellent bullet speed with improved damage falloff, very lethal headshot damage and more penetration than 7.62x39mm but lowers your close range performance!

.338 Norma.info: Loads your Arctic Warfare with .338 Norma Magnum. This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length. While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it retains your one shot limb range while improving your firing speed!

SASS 358 Conversion.info:
An alternate ammo type for the SASS 308.
 The .358 Winchester cartridge gives your SASS weapon more power close up towards an enemies torso, trading long range performance. A perfect panic backup.

TAR Duplex Ammo.info: Specialty Colt 5.56x45 ammo stuffed with 2 bullets stacked on eachother. Splits the stats, and uses a smaller magazine than normal. More powerful than you'd expect, and reloads swiftly.

R10/22 .17 HMR.info:
Converts your R10/22 to fire .17 HMR, a wildcat cartridge that is weaker than .22 LR but has significantly higher speed!
Worse penetration performance resulting in terrible torso damage but can one shot to the head up close and has massively more muzzle velocity!

MK11 500 Conversion.info:
Convert your MK11 to fire .500 Phantom. Made specifically for the AR10 platform.
Very slow bullet, increased recoil, but with a dramatic power increase.

R10/22 Rat Shot.info:
Loads your R10/22 with small .22 Rat Shot bullets, each firing 10 pellets with little spread!
Powerful up close, especially to the head but has very poor muzzle velocity, penetration and ranged performance!

R10/22 Full-Auto Conv.info:
A dubiously legal conversion kit that lets you fire full-auto!
I'm not sure why you would want this, but it is an option.

SA58 .45 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into .45 ACP.
Heavily modifies performance befitting of the pistol caliber it is firing.
Comes Packed with an aftermarket modified Thompson 50-round drum.

SKORP 9x18mm Conversion.info:
Load your Skorpion with 9x18mm Makarov.
Loading from a 30 round magazine, you lose a small amount of close range performance with reduced damage in range while retaining the same range profile. Higher bullet velocity and a higher firerate.

SHORTY .45 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into .45 ACP.
Heavily modifies performance befitting of the pistol caliber it is firing.
Comes Packed with an aftermarket modified Thompson 50-round drum.

SA58 5.56 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into 5.56x45mm NATO.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.
Comes Packed with standard issue 30-round STANAG Magazinse.

.338 Norma (TRG-42).info: Loads your TRG with .338 Norma Magnum. This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length. While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it focuses on improving your firing speed!

AR 25-45 Conversion.info:
Loads your AR-15 with .25-45 Sharps.
 This uses the classic 20-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. Decreases reload time, but you'll be punished even more if shots are missed.

GSP Rat Shot.info: Aiming? You don't need to do that. Just spitball tiny, almost harmless pellets at people until they ask you to stop. It cannot even properly cycle rounds, forcing you to manually cycle the bullets each shot.

K14 .308 Winchester.info:
Load your K14 with .308 Winchester.
Fitted with a 5 round magazine, the K14 gains more favourable sniper traits with additional reload speed, but less rounds are carried.

Deagle 50 357.info: A .44 wildcat round developed using a necked-down .50 AE cartridge for use in the Desert Eagle XIX. Stronger ballistic performance at range at the cost of some close-range power.

Timberwolf .308.info:
A .308 Winchester conversion kit for the Timberwolf, turning it into the lighter Coyote rifle.
Possesses a simpler damage profile that allows you to kill to the torso up close, but lacks the raw power and performance of the other available ammo types.

Mateba 6 .454 Casull.info: Chambers your Mateba Autorevolver in .454 Casull - giving it a massive increase in stopping power up close at the cost of having a lower rate of fire, increased recoil, and slightly worse handling.

Saiga 223 Conversion.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in .223 Rem. with a 40 round magazine!
Uses some ''legal'' modifications to the receiver to turn your SAR fully automatic. Treat this as an assault rifle with an extended magazine!

SSR 6.5 Conversion.info:
Transforms your gun into the ''MK20S'' firing 6.5mm Creedmoor!
Slightly shorter round that has better velocity, lower recoil and the ability to one shot head at all ranges!
Significantly worse anywhere outside the head and reduced penetration!

Saiga 762 Conversion.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 7.62x39mm with a 30rd magazine!
Keeps damage high especially to the torso while also increasing your fire rate, but lowers overall damage and penetration!

M14 6.5.info:
Loads your M14 with 6.5mm Creedmoor.
This cartridge offers your M14 more assault rifle characteristics such as lower damage, alongside a 30 round magazine. Slight improvements to penetration, velocity and recoil.

RPK12 7.62 Conversion.info:
A conversion kit chambering the RPK-12 for 7.62x39mm, designed as a potential replacement for the RPK in service to go alongside the 5.45x39 upgrade.

Increased damage and recoil with slightly less magazine capacity and a slightly longer reload time.

.17 HMR (Ruger).info:
Converts your R-10/22 rifle to fire .17 HMR, providing excellent velocity and long-range headshot performance. This conversion kit also comes with a modified charging handle that makes the gun manually operated, acting as a straight-pull bolt action!

Animation likely completely broken, WIP.

Saiga 545 Conversion.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 5.45x39mm with a 45 round magazine!
Lowers recoil, increases fire rate, magazine capacity and bullet speed while keeping a good range performance but comes at a cost of close range damage, penetration and some handling!

UMP 9 Conversion.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your PDX-45 into the PDX-9.
Stats adjusted accordingly to the caliber being fired.

AUG .300 Conversion.info:
Loads your UAR A3 with supersonic .300 Blackout.
Improves close range damage and penetration at the cost of worse ranged damage and bullet speed.
Reduces radar detection range further by 50% with suppressors!

M21 6.5.info:
Loads your M21 with 6.5mm Creedmoor.
Featuring a 20 round magazine, your M21 has its performance affected due 6.5mm. However, you suffer from weaker headshot damage and overall modifier reductions.

SVU-A Conversion Kit.info: Change the internals of your SVU sniper rifle into that of the SVU-A with an extended magazine. Treat it as a hard to control battle rifle (especially in auto which should only be used for emergencies)...

SCAR L 9mm Conversion.info:
Converts your MK16 SOCOM to fire 9x19mm using a conversion kit.
Uses a 50rd drum magazine. Focusses on CQC by increasing the fire rate, close range damage and reducing the recoil but at the cost of ranged damage, bullet speed and penetration!

RM277 7.62x51 Conversion.info:
Converts your RM 277 to fire 7.62x51mm NATO, a more traditional cartridge with a more traditional damage profile.

High damage with a simplified damage profile but decreases fire rate and muzzle velocity and increases recoil.

AutoMag .50 AE Conversion.info:
Load your AutoMag with .50 Action Express.
This makes your AutoMag III into the .50 caliber AutoMag V using a 5-round magazine. Featuring stopping power similar to other .50 caliber handguns.

AK12BR 7.62 Conversion.info:
A conversion kit that rechambered the AK-12BR prototype for 7.62x39mm, using a more conventional drum magazine.
Lower recoil for the caliber, but also lower damage. High rate of fire.

Folded Grip.info:
Fold up the integral grip of your weapon.
Provides small aimspeed and walkspeed benefits with poorer hipfire.

Romanian Grip.info:
A sturdy tactical foregrip that improves gun stability and vertical camera recoil but has worse horizontal recoil control, handling and mobility while aiming.

[GAIN]
-20% Translation recoil.
-10% Vertical camera body (X) recoil.
-10% Vertical camera Body (X) recoil climb.
-10% Hipfire spread.

-25% Scope sway.

Folding Grip.info:
A lightweight grip with the ability to fold up when not in use. Not as great at reducing recoil as other sturdier grips.

Reduces horizontal recoil variance by 10%.
Improves horizontal stability by 30%
Slightly improves rotational and translational recoil by 10%
12.5% improved equip and unequip speed
10% more weapon sway when moving
5% worse handling

Pistol Grip.info:
A grip typically used for your trigger hand now mounted to the front of your gun!

20% less vertical rotational recoil.
8% less gun kick
10% less muzzle climb
15% less gun sway
10% better hipfire stability
10% worse handling and aiming walkspeed
12% more horizontal camera recoil

Vertical Grip.info:
A standard vertical foregrip that fights against climbing recoil while improving hipfire but has worse horizontal recoil control and handling.

[GAIN]
- -8% Rotation X recoil.
- -20% Camera Body X rising recoil.
- -20% Rotational X rising recoil.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-30% Walk sway.
+10% Sprint transition speeds.

Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.
Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

Skeleton Grip.info:
A skeletonized pistol grip that provides ergonomic improvements, but does little to help your recoil management.

15% improved gun sway
10% faster aiming speeds
15% faster sprint transition time
10% faster equip & unequip speeds
10% slower walkspeed while aiming
Slightly improved vertical gun kick
Slightly worse horizontal recoil variance

infolist: Decreased weapon rotation and translation recoil.
Slightly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

Remove Grip.info:
Removes the grip from your MP-9!
Improves handling for increased recoil!

Handstop.info:
A low-profile handstop to help you maintain a stable firing position.

Lowers rearward kick by 25%, reduces rearward kick variance by 55%
Slightly improves horizontal and vertical translational recoil and kick
Slightly increases vertical and horizontal variance
10% faster sprint speeds
15% faster aim time
3% better aiming walkspeed
10% lower weapon sway when aiming down sights or scoped in

Angled Grip.info:
An angled foregrip that doubles as a handstop, providing an extremely sturdy grip position while being relatively low profile.

Reduces translational recoil by 30%
Improves horizontal rotational recoil by 10%
Reduces gun sway by 20%
7.5% faster sprint transition speeds
Increases gun kick by 10%
Reduces aiming walkspeed by 10%
Reduces aiming and equip speeds by 5%

Carry Handle Grip.info: A peculiar mounting of the M16's carry handle, often done to prevent it from getting lost. I guess it works as a grip though?

Olympic Forgrip.info:
This grip is counterweighted to help improve how fast you can aim.
Ideal for taking aim at targets faster with small improvements to your sway and steady time, offset with hindered walkspeed while aiming.

Nylon Strap Grip.info:
A unique strap grip for the MAC-10 and MAC-11. Decreases muzzle flip significantly, lowers vertical camera randomness and aim sway while walking.
However, increases vertical translation recoil, increases the speed of camera rise while firing and slows down aim speed!

Box Grip.info: Install the original M1A1 box grip back onto the Tommy gun. Minor stat changes.

infolist: Decreased weapon rotation and translation recoil.
Greatly decreased camera body X recoil.
Slightly decreased camera body YZ recoil.
Slightly increased weapon rotation look sway speed.
Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.
Decreased camera body YZ recoil and variance.
Slightly decreased weapon rotation look sway.
Slightly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.
Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

Potato Grip.info:
A bulbous foregrip with an integrated flashlight accessory that is surprisingly effective and won't slide away.
Not for consumption.

[GAIN]
-10% Camera body recoil.
+5% Aiming walkspeed.
+5% Aiming speed.
Lights up dark areas.

[LOSS]
Flashlight is visible to enemies.

Diopter Sight Open.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

H&K Export Sight.info: Iron sights found on the STG-91 series of weapons. These sights in particular are export models for some STG-91 rifles and features a rear sight with two aperatures.

Lyman Sight.info:
Flip up the Thompson's rear sight.
The Lyman sight was created specifically for the Thompson. It is primarily found on Soveran models of the weapon and exists on most Thompsons.

Aftermarket Sight.info: Special aftermarket iron sights for the M82A1!

Gen 3 Rear Sight.info: Equip the third generation (2016) AK-12 rear iron sight.

Double Open Sight.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

DT Siege Sight.info: The perfect sight for takin' down them no good dirty scoundrels held up in that thar' darn house!

Kalashnikov Sight.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

Unfolded Leaf Sight.info: Raise your leaf sight on your weapon. Leaf sights are hinged sights that can be raised up or down and adjusted to account for targets in range.

Bundeswehr Sight.info: Iron sights found on the MG3KWS. Press T for an LMG-style alternate aim mode.

Carry Handle Sight RRA.info: Iron sights found on M16 family weapons. These iron sights ditch that whole carry handle thing and give the aesthetic of some M16 iron sights without needing the carry handle.

Herstal Sight.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

DT11 Target Sight.info: An elevated sight typically used for target shootin'.

Half Ring Sight.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

Dual Aperture Sight.info: Iron sights found on the Vector. These sights were developed by Troy Industries and are unique with the rear sights diamond shape.

Carry Handle Sight ACR.info: Iron sights found on M16 family weapons. These iron sights ditch that whole carry handle thing and give the aesthetic of some M16 iron sights without needing the carry handle.

AAC Flip Up Sight.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

Izhmash Sight.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

KAC Sight.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

Steyr Sight.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

Carry Handle Sight.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

Diopter Sight.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

H&K Sight.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

Troy Flip Up Sight.info: Iron sights found on the SA58 SPR!

Valorise Irons.info: Iron sights from the FAMAS Valorise configuration.

IWI Sight.info: Iron sights found on the Tavor family of weapons. These sights have a very modern appearance to them with its rear sight ring and slim front post, making aiming a breeze.

Remove Irons.info: You prefer to aim your gun with no assistance?

Full Ring Sight.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

Quick-Release Sight.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

1200M Sight.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

Kel-Tec Sight.info: Iron sights found on the KSG 12. These irons were developed by Kel-Tec as flip up sights.

Super Slim Sight.info: Iron sights found on the UAR A3.

BUIS Sight.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

SVU Backup Sights.info: Flip up the SVU's built in ironsights!

Backup Sight.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

Sako Backup Sight.info: Alternate iron sights for the Sako TRG-42.

MBUS Sight.info: Iron sights found on the TRG-42. The Magpul Back Up Sight is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

5.56x45mm MiniFix.info: Swap your caliber to 5.56x45mm. Increases performance overall, but reduces penetration. Extreme headshot multiplier.

MP5 Burst Trigger Group.info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9 to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage and performance in close range but damage drops off faster. Easier to control recoil.

30rd Mag.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold 30 rounds. Reduced total spare rounds carried, slower reload and walkspeed.

Snail MiniFix.info:
Swap your standard capacity magazine for a 90-round drum.
A heavy magazine to fill your needs of never having to reload again... until you need to!

MAC-11 Buffer M.info:
A medium buffer for your MAC-11!
Moderately increases fire rate but lowers rotational damping and increases rising camera recoil!

MAC-10 Buffer M.info:
A medium buffer for your MAC-10!
Moderately increases fire rate but lowers rotational damping and increases rising camera recoil!

e Shotgun HDS.info:
Adjust your settings to be fit for home defence scenarios.
Weapon is locked to burst fire with adjusted performance.

Heavy Buffer.info: A heavier buffer spring that helps to reduce rate of fire and recoil, making a gun more controllable.

35rd Box Mag.info: A Zarovian designated 35-round box magazine that originally came with the PPSH-41. Increases general mobility due to it's lighter weight, and recoil will be a bit easier to control.

Straight Pull Bolt.info:
Advanced marksman training allows you to channel your inner zen, aligning all your chakras.
Subsequently, you don't lose focus when aiming down sights, can cycle freely, have a lot less weapon sway and can hold breath for longer while scoping.
Your zen state, however, reduces your aim walkspeed, aim speed and equip/unequip speed!

M16 Burst Trigger Group.info: Change the trigger group of your M16A3 to fire in 3-round burst and semi-automatic, making it an M16A2. Improves weapon damage and performance at long range.

FAMAS G2 Conversion.info:
Change the internals of your FAMAS F1 with those of the FAMAS G2 assault rifle.
Increases RPM by 200 and grants a 30-round stanag magazine, but damage is lowered, reload and aim is slower. Hipfire is a little worse.

MP-9 Remove Limiter.info:
Removes the fire rate limiter from your MP-9 allowing it to fire at the full 1500 RPM!
Results in less accuracy and is not compatible with the drum magazine.

Five-Seven Full Auto.info: An aftermarket modification turning the gun into a full-auto machine gun - at the cost of rapidly dumping the contents of the magazine after pulling the trigger.

FIVE-0 Full-Auto Trigger Group.info: Change the trigger group of your FIVE-0 to make it fire in full-automatic and semi-automatic. Lowers your firerate, ranges, and increases recoil somewhat.

Reduced MiniFix.info: Swap your standard capacity magazines for 20 round M16 magazines. Reduced capacity, increased overall handling!

Pro Mag.info:
A 50 round drum magazine for the Ruger 10/22, and by extension, the ZIP 22. Yeah, that's right, 50 rounds of .22 Long Rifle. Reduces mobility and aiming speed.
To have the pro mag, you must be a pro.

Gyrojet Full-Auto Conversion.info:
You ever wonder how the Grand Federation had made it to the moon? Rockets of course!
This fits your Gyrojet with the capability of firing in automatic. Trading off semi-auto performance for full-auto rocket power!

Heavy Bolt.info: The bolt is replaced by a much heavier one made by Beretta, slowing down the RPM and general mobility but makes the gun easier to control.

P90 Civvy Mag.info:
Despite looking like a typical P90 magazine this one can only hold thirty rounds and was made for the civilian market.
Less rounds in a magazine (obviously), but slightly better mobility and reload speed.

BWC9 Fire Selector Burst.info: Adds a fire selector to your BWC9. Capable of firing in 3 shot burst.

AUG Burst Group.info:
Changes the trigger grouping of your UAR favoring a 3-round burst over full auto.
Slightly raises headshot and torso damage while also slightly reducing recoil.

AUG HBAR Closed Bolt Conversion.info: Convert your UAR HEAVY to fire from a closed bolt. Reduces weapon firerate and gives it more general accuracy in exchange. Can load an extra round in the chamber!

MAC-11 Buffer S.info:
A small buffer for your MAC-11!
Slightly increases fire rate but slightly lowers rotational damping and increases rising camera recoil!

Speedloader.info: A lightweight piece of kit that is perfect for making reloading revolvers a breeze. When you use all of your rounds in the cylinder, you can reload at a faster rate! However it comes at the cost of a slower reload when theres unspent rounds in the cylinder.

CS/LR Marksman Kit.info: Advanced marksman training allows you to channel your inner zen, aligning all of your chakras. Subsequently, you don't lose focus when aiming down sights, and can cycle freely. Your zen state, however, reduces your RPM.

Spring Mod.info: A spring modification that somehow miraculously doesn't jam every 2 shots, may have some unexpected side effects though.

Heavy Bolt (MG42).info: The bolt is replaced by a much heavier one, slowing down the RPM and movement but making the gun easier to control.

CSMG Burst Trigger Group.info:
Change the trigger group of your XM633 to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Making it by technicality, the M639 SMG. Easier to control recoil.

e Shotgun CCS.info:
Adjust your settings to be fit for crowd control scenarios.
Weapon is locked to automatic fire with adjusted performance.

TCR Duplex Binary.info: A binary-trigger group allows you to fire your gun on a trigger pull and to fire again once you let go. Duplex rounds not included.

BOOMBOX Semi Group.info:
Changes the trigger grouping of your Doombox to be semi-automatic only!
Raises headshot & torso damage but reduces fire rate allowing you to play it like a subsonic DMR!

GS Slam Fire.info: Allows your Golden Shorty to slam fire at a fast rate by holding down the firing button at the cost of larger spread!

DSR Remove Mag.info:
Removes the front magazine from your gun to lower its weight, increasing mobility while aiming and handling speed.
But this lowers your reserve ammo pool.

Light Bolt (MG42).info: The bolt is replaced by a much lighter one, increasing the RPM and some mobility but making the gun harder to control!

SKORP Rate Limiter.info: Removes the firerate limiter from your Skorpion machine pistol granting it to be fired faster. A drawback to removing the limiter will severely impact your weapons recoil.

SPAS-12 Pump-Action.info:
Switch the firemode to pump-action typically used for lower pressure rounds.
Better accuracy, worse RPM.
Free!

AUG DMR Burst Group.info: Adds a 3-round burst trigger group to the UAR A3M2 for a unique trigger control flavor.

M1919 Conversion.info:
Change the internals of your Thompson with those of the experimental M1919 submachine gun.
Expect your firerate to go up, but your handling to drop extensively...

Trench Sweeper.info: Change your internals of your Typewriter with those of the experimental M1919 submachine gun. Insanely high fire rate and improves your handling significantly but comes at the cost of a limited 30 round magazine and wild recoil!

MP5K Burst Trigger Group.info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9K to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage to torsos an damage overall giving more breathing room in range if you hit torso shots. Easier to control recoil.

MP5SD Burst Trigger Group.info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9SD to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage and performance at further distances with damage dropping off slower. Generally easier to control recoil.

AA-12 Semi Conversion.info:
Change the internals of your AA-12 to make it able to fire in semi automatic like the closed-bolt civilian variant.
Better choke accuracy, but less rpm. Can carry an extra round in the chamber.

MP5/10 Burst Trigger Group.info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9/10 to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage and performance in close range but damage drops off faster with poorer damage in range. Easier to control recoil.

50rd Drum.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold a whopping 50 rounds. This heavy magazine greatly reduces spare rounds carried, slows reload and handling speed, and slows your walkspeed, but at least you'll feel like a mobster.

HCAR Open bolt.info: Converts your HCAR to be fully automatic but gives up the ability to shoot semi-automatic.

BWC9 Fire Selector Semi.info: Removes the fire selector making it the commercial BWC9.

MAC-11 Buffer L.info:
A large buffer for your MAC-11!
Largely increases fire rate but significantly lowers rotational damping and increases rising camera recoil!

Improved Choke.info:
Chokes are cylinders attached to the barrel to tighten the spread. This one is the least constrictive of the chokes, offering little gain but little drawback. Perfect for pursuitin' them upland birds!
Don't ask how it works with slugs, okay?

Modified Choke.info:
The middle ground of the chokes, offering more bang for your buck(shot)! Better benefits, but also worse losses. Perfect for huntin' some waterfouls.
Don't ask how it works with slugs, okay?

Flash Hider.info:
Eliminates the muzzle flash from unburnt propellants while firing by cooling and dispersing burning gases that exit the muzzle.

Improves visual recoil by 20%, hides the gun's flash, and provides a modest 60 stud minimap masking range.
Your minimap marker also fades 40% faster.
Very slightly improves hipfire stability.

Muzzle Booster (Alt).info: Makes the recoil higher in general.

Diverter.info: The kind of choke that was made when someone looked at duckbill and didn't think it was enough. Further decreases your vertical spread but increases the horizontal spread even more than before!

Compensator.info:
A compensating muzzle device.
40% less horizontal recoil variance
15% more vertical muzzle kick and variance
25% more muzzle climb
Slightly worse hipfire spread and stability.

Muzzle Booster.info:
8% RPM increase.
Increases the rate of fire by increasing recoil forces, but that also makes the recoil higher in general. Reduced suppression.

T-Brake.info: While not as effective as the compensator or muzzle brake at reducing specific recoil patterns, the T-brake reduces both vertical and horizontal camera recoil. This heavier brake also slightly reduces aiming speeds by 3% and increases your radar signature, making your radar blips last 50% longer.

Loudener.info: You may have originally believed this was used for Hollywood movies, NOPE! The loudener as its name suggests makes your gun LOUDER and makes the muzzle blast more concussive! Not just that, but it also increases your SUPPRESSION and reduces vertical recoil and muzzle velocity.

Muzzle Brake.info:
A standard muzzle device which reduces vertical recoil climb by dispersing muzzle gases horizontally.

40% reduction in vertical kick
15% increase to vertical stability
15% less vertical rotational recoil
20% less muzzle climb

15% more horizontal recoil variance

Duckbill Choke.info:
This choke just doesn't tighten spread, it does it horizontally.
Lower velocity, tighter vertical spread, more horizontal spread.

Halbek Device.info: A device designed to mitigate recoil on the FAL platform, but for some reason it functionally 'inverts' recoil here! The halbek device causes your gun to recoil in a downwards manner to reduce muzzle climb. However its performance heavily depends on the gun.

Paradox Choke.info:
Otherwise known as a ''spreader''.
A strange but simple choke that is simply an extension to the barrel with rifling.
Unlike other choke this one works great with slugs!

X-Ring.info:
Unlike other muzzle attachments, this unusual device improves rotational recoil and gun displacement. Slightly higher felt camera recoil and a little less effective with hipfire.
Not very effective at blowing up moon-sized battlestations.

Full Choke.info: The choke with the tighest constriction, offering the tightest spread of pellets. Great for long range precision shots, but beware of missing your shots up close.

Coyote Sight.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

DeltaPoint Sight.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

Kousaku Sight.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

OKP-7.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

Kousaku OLED Sight.info: A OLED display built into a reflex sight. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

Z-Point.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

MACRO P-1.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

Comp Aimpoint.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

EOTech XPS2.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

Delta Sight.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

UH Gen1.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

EOTech 552.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

Microdot SRS.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

Reflex Sight.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

Kobra EKP Sight.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

Microdot Mini.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

DCL 120.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

Kobra Sight.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

DDHB Reflex.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

Mini Sight.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

Barska Electro.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

Pilad 3.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

MARS.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

EOTech M40.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

PKA-S.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

TA01 Acog.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

Vcog 6x Scope.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

Klassik LM.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3x

The Klassik LM 2.5-10x is the primary scope found on the WA2000. Also developed by Sm & Bender made for those who take their weapons to range, or prefer to go hunting.
Low sway with mediocre sway speed and average steady time.

PM II Ultrashort.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3.5x

The Sm & Bender PM II Ultrashort is one of the world's shortest yet fully functional sniper scopes.
Due to its short design, it is easily suitable for semi-automatic rifles with short rails.

Vcog 8x Scope.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

Tango MSR 1-8x.info: A standard LPVO scope designed for the M7 NGSW program!

Steyr Integrated Scope.info: Integrated railed version of the UAR scope.

PU-1 Scope.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

Hensoldt 3x Sight.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

Malcolm 3x Scope.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

Leupold M8-6x.info: The Leupold M8-6x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. It's renowned for its toughness.

FF 3x NV.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

PSO-1M2 Scope.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

Electra 5x.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

Sagittarius 40x.info:
Press T to zoom out to 10x.
A very large scope designed by Vector Optics for law enforcement and tactical use, this optics very high zoom allows you to get uncompromised view on enemies. Or, switch to 10x magnification for closer engagements.

KOM 10x42.info: A modified version of the scope made by Kalinka Optics. Press T to shift to 3x zoom.

CS/OS15.info:
The CS/OS15 (8x-32x) is a Jinhanian variable zoom optic with a very simple crosshair used primarily as a long-range daytime optic on the CS/LS3 and CS/LS4 snipers.

It can be changed from a default zoom of 10x to an alternate zoom of 3.5x with the alt-aim key (T).

SUSAT Scope.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

M145.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

C79.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

TA11 Acog.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

Leupold Mark 4.info:
A Grand Federation variable-zoom optic which is somewhat lacking in features by modern optic standards. Nevertheless, it is considered reliable and can be found on numerous military rifles from the early 2000s.

10x blackscope with access to a 5x alt aim (T).

FN 4x Scope.info:
A simple in-house manufactured optic made especially for the FAL rifles along the custom dust cover to mount the scope, provides a clear sight image being simple to read although isn't meant for really long ranges.

Model by Rialag

VHS-D2 CT 1.5x.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The VHS-D2 CT 1.5x is an integrated telescopic scope for the VHS-D2.

EOTech Vudu 1-10.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

PSO-12.7.info:
A Zarovian large caliber scope that debuted on the VKS rifle.

Its origins and information are still relatively unknown, but it appears to be designed to withstand large caliber rounds such as the 12.7x55mm cartridge. This name was chosen based on the existing PSO family name "Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky" (Optical Sniper Sight) and a reference to its caliber rating.

Acog Scope.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

Reflector Scope.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

PSO-1 Scope.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

Hensoldt Dual Optic.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

Malcolm 6x Scope.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Long version of the Malcolm scope design.

TA33 Acog.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

PM II.info: The Sm & Bender PM II is a 10x scope originally designed and intended for use on the AWM series of bolt action sniper rifles. It is the perfect choice for military and police forces looking for uncompromised accuracy.

Swarovski Scope.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

Hensoldt Z24.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

PK-A.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

TA44 Acog.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

ZF69 Scope.info: A Nomensland fixed-power precision riflescope used as the primary optic for the UAR HBAR-T configuration.

Colt Retro Scope.info: A reissued version of the original M16A1 4x21mm rifle scope, mounting directly to the gun's carry handle. Minimal impact on handling.

NXS 5.5-22.info: The NXS 5.5-22 is the scope found on the INTERVENTION. Developed by Nightforce optics it is one of their most proven optics as a long range rifle scope.

HD-N 4-16x44.info:
Full zoom: 12.0x
Alt zoom: 4.0x

A scope with a fairly unusual adjustment dial design. Possesses improved scope sway over other similar scopes, but is somewhat more unwieldy to use.

Leupold M8-2x.info: The Leupold M8-2x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. A smaller form factor means greater handling capability.

Global Offensive Scope.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

Unertl 8x Scope.info: The standard issue scope for the Springfield M1903. This absurdly long target scope was designed by John Unertl and was found to be the best for the requirements of the military at the time.

SIDEWINDER ED.info: The Sidewinder ED is the optic found on the HECATE II. It is an optic developed by Hawkes Optics and, hence it's name includes a signuature sidewinder on the side of the optic.

Olympian Target Sight.info: A targeting sight made specifically for the FT300. It technically isn't a scope, it's more like a zoomed in iron sight!

PRO 3-9x Scope.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

Tac C Note.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

Furro Sight.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

Anti Sight.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

Plague Insight.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

Handmade Sight.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

Maglite.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

OEG.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

AMT-Terminator.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

Hand Sight.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

Animu Sight.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

Glock Stock 2.info: A Grand Federation-made stock which folds over in front of your G-Series pistol. Reduces rotational recoil while increasing camera recoil.

MP5K Stock.info: Specially made stock for the SMX-9K. Reduces rotational recoil while increasing camera recoil.

Glock Stock Folded.info: A Grand Federation-made stock which you have folded over in front of your G-Series pistol. Now you have a foregrip! Featuring similar attributes to the Angled Grip.

Full Stock 3.info:
An extended stock, providing a better firing position.

Improves kick damper, kick speed, and general recoil. Reduces aim speed, maneuverability, and hipfire stability.

Braced Stock.info: A braced stock with an ergonomic design that makes it faster to aim down the sights, while also improving gun sway while moving and while aiming down the sights. This stock also improves breath time on scopes and scope sway.

Remove Stock.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

Extended Stock (ALT).info: Fold out the weapon's stock for greater stability.

Police Stock.info: What's a sheriff without his deputy? This stock will be at your side to through the best and worst times. Treat it with respect.

AK-308 Gen 4 Stock.info:
Gen 4 Stock Aesthetic.

Improved recoil management, but slightly increase aim and sprint transition times.

Boom Stock.info: Reinstalls the stock to your SAWED-OFF, improving camera kick recovery and reducing overall aimed kick.

DT Sporting Stock.info: A sturdy stock found on the DT11 ACS. It will certainly aid in recoil control for any situation, but the weight may become a hinderance for movement.

MGV176 Folded.info: Folds your stock. Adds to your vertical and horizontal recoil by 30%.

Magazine Stock.info: Do away with a conventional weapon stock, the PP-2000 has a space for you to place your spare magazines! Increased reserve count, but expect less stability.

Full Stock 2.info:
A sturdier stock to help mitigate recoil.

Significantly improves how much the gun kicks backward when firing.
Somewhat improves general gun kick.
Improved scope breath time and breath recovery.
Worse handling and slightly longer reload times.

KAC Stock.info:
The R SQUARED stock taken off and placed onto the RH-44.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

Glock Stock.info: An Eretz-Kedem stock for the G-series pistols. Reduces rotational recoil while increasing camera recoil.

Taurus Stock.info:
The Taurus carbine kit stock placed onto your revovler.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

Retract Stock.info:
Fold in the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

MC51SD Stock.info: STG-89C's stock now extended out. Reduces recoil while reducing mobility and hipfire stability.

DT Olympian Stock.info: Adjustable stock found on the DT11 PRO. It will certainly cushion the recoil but you will not lose out on mobility. However aiming is slower.

Obrez Stock.info: Reattach the stock to the OBREZ in order to decrease the recoil kick, at the cost of some other areas.

SCAR TRS Stock.info:
A special TPR stock for the SOCOM rifle family.
Sturdy stock perfect for combat in trying times.
Improves kick damper, kick speed, and general recoil. Reduces aim speed, maneuverability, and hipfire stability.

Light Stock.info:
A lighter alternative over the default stock.
Improves mobility and handling speed but increases recoil due to missing recoil buffer parts. Increases weapon sway when scoping and walking.

HK51B Stock.info: Extend out the MG89B. Generally reduces recoil with mobility drawbacks.

Full Stock.info:
A sturdier stock to help mitigate recoil.

Significantly improves how much the gun kicks backward when firing.
Somewhat improves general gun kick.
Improved scope breath time and breath recovery.
Worse handling and slightly longer reload times.

M231 Wire Stock.info: Aftermarket wire stock fitted onto your illegal firearm. Do you really expect this to help..?

Stakeout II Grip.info:
A sawn off stakeout grip for your M37!
Improves aim, equip and sprint transition speed, and increases walkspeed.
However, increases recoil and weapon sway due to the lack of stock.

M16A2 Buffer Stock.info: Uses the buffer tube from a traditional M16A2 to significantly increase your fire rate, destabilizes your recoil and reduces damage performance!

MAC10 Fold Stock.info:
Folds your stock on the MAC to improve handling, aim walkspeed and reduces camera recoil!
Increases aim sway while walking but also rotational and translation recoil!

Teufort Grip.info:
A specialized short grip straight out of Teufort!
Improves aim, equip and sprint transition speed, and increases walkspeed.
However, increases recoil and weapon sway due to the lack of stock.
And if that don't work: Use more gun.

DSR Light Stock.info:
A lighter version of the DSR-50's stock.
Improves mobility and handling speed but increases recoil due to missing recoil buffer parts. Increases weapon sway when scoping and walking.

ZIP Stock.info: Specially made stock for the ZIP 22. Reduces rotational recoil while increasing camera recoil.

ITHACA Sawn Off.info:
Cut off the weapon's stock for better equip, aim, walkspeed, and recoil recovery speed.
Accuracy is hindered from the offset weight and lack of a stock.

FAL PRS Full Stock.info: PRS full polymer stock. Modern lightweight solution for making your FAL more ergonomic to handle. Moderately increases camera recoil

AK12 Gen 3 Stock.info:
Equip the third generation (2016) AK-12 furniture setup.

Older stock design that enabled slightly faster shouldering while having a slightly worse cheek weld for camera recoil management.

Mac10 Stock.info: Extend the default stock out to reduce overall camera recoil with some minor handling and reload speed reductions.

AK15 Gen 4 Stock.info:
Gen 4 Stock Aesthetic.

Improved recoil management, but slightly increase aim and sprint transition times.

FAL Marksman Stock.info: Improves your cheekweld for better control over recoil while aiming but slightly reduces your aimspeed getting into position.

Rex Stock.info: Custom built stock for the MP412. Based on the average pistol stock, it allows for greater stability while firing. For some reason this is considered a big no-no for some folks, however you are in an active warzone so that doesn't matter.

Shoulder Stock.info:
A pistol stock that helps to brace against recoil and maintain a more stable firing position.

Reduces muzzle flip and gun sway significantly, but overall worse handling.

Collapsible Stock.info: Alternative lightweight stock with the ability to fold down or collapse. Lightens your weapon, but makes it slightly more front-heavy in the process - slightly increasing vertical gun rotation.

Extended Stock.info: Extend out the weapon stock for greater aiming recoil reduction while increasing aiming and sprint to aim time.

Shorty Stock.info: FAL PARA SHORTY's stock now folded out. Reduces transitional and rotational recoil. Increases camera recoil and decreases maneuverability.

Short Chop.info: Equip your Fix with the Short Chop, a medium suppressor designed for the heavy caliber. Increases ranges, deadly quiet. Do not use to break boards. 30 Stud detection radius.

FT300 Suppressor.info: An integral suppressor for the FT300 competition rifle. Preserve damage, range and increases the torso multiplier in exchange for poorer velocity. Lower suppression radius.

Suppressor (DT11).info: Integral Suppressor for your competition shotgun. Preserves range and damage and the weight reduces felt weapon recoil. With small velocity, spread and weight penalties.

Sionics Suppressor.info:
No detection radius.

A unique suppressor designed for the MAC-10, famous for being so quiet that the action can be heard cycling. A mixture of the long barrel and heavy suppressor. Great for close range combat, but can be decently useful at long range too.

PBS-4 Suppressor.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A medium suppressor that reduces rotational recoil while also mildly reducing camera body recoil and increasing range performance slightly with average sound masking.
Reduces mobility and handling.

Integral U416.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the U-527/22.

Improves performance at close range at the cost of ranged performance and velocity. Excellent masking.

SLX Suppressor.info:
20 stud detection radius.

The new standard military suppressor for the M7!
Slightly increases damage ranges, bullet speed and lowers muzzle flip at the cost of a bit more vertical camera recoil and slightly slower handling!

Vikhr Suppressor.info:
A Zarovian suppressor akin to the one used on the AS VAL.
This suppressor behaves as a longer barrel giving your gun less recoil and preserving damage, slightly increased ranges with slower mobility, handling and reload speed as a tradeoff.

SD Barrel.info: Equip your Mini Fix with an integrally suppressed barrel. Reduces performance at range. 0 Stud detection radius.

Integrated BREN3.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the VZ.808 rifle. Increases close-range damage while reducing damage at range.
25 studs detection range.

Suppressor..?.info:
Wait, what are you doing? Stop, this literally doesn't give you any benefit. Why are you like this?
(It does nothing but pitch up your fire sound. Do not buy).

Suppressor (RAILGUN).info:
50% muzzle velocity loss.
50 stud detection radius.

How on earth do you suppress this thing?

Trash Panda.info: Equip your Mini Fix with the Trash Panda, a medium suppressor. Reduces performance at range. Pairs well with 5.56x45mm. 30 Stud detection radius. Do not bring near dumpsters.

LMX Suppressor.info:
25 stud detection radius.

An unique suppressor designed for the X46A2!
Improves mid-range performance at the cost of some handling.

Suppressor.info:
70 stud detection radius.

A general purpose balanced duty suppressor.
Provides decent sound masking, well-rounded recoil reductions but a trade-off in handling speed and mobility while aiming.

R2 Suppressor.info:
100 stud detection radius.

A light suppressor that compromises on sound masking range with a minor reduction to recoil and minimal impact to handling.

Q Pork Chop.info:
0 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor designed for large .30-cal magnum calibers. Deadly quiet. Improves damage ranges. Do not eat.

SHAK-12 Heavy Suppressor.info: A heavyweight suppressor for the ShAK-12 which provides excellent masking & sound suppression as well as improved recoil at the cost of handling.

Maxim Silencer.info:
The first successful suppressor design.
An old suppressor from 1909 that saw limited use on the M1903 Springfield. Being one of the first suppressors, it is not as effective as modern ones available to you, but does have its own range of benefits.

Muffler (Alt).info:
10% muzzle velocity lost.
No sound masking 
Cheap homemade 'suppressor' that reduces the volume of shots fired / recoil of a gun, but will still set off radars and in this case, will not affect firerate.

ARS Suppressor.info:
30 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor that has the greatest masking performance improvements.
It also reduces overall recoil significantly due to its weight while also lowering mobility and handling the most.

HB Trash Panda.info:
0 stud detection radius.

Lengthened barrel with a trash panda suppressor at the end.
Improves range, bullet speed and penetration while suppressing your gun at the cost of worse movement and handling.
Does not reduce recoil and weapon sway due to a lack of extended handguard.

HB SD Suppressor.info:
0 stud detection radius.

Lengthened barrel & handguard with a dedicated SD suppressor.
Improves range, bullet speed and penetration while suppressing your gun at the cost of worse movement and handling.
The lengthened handguard provides lower recoil, hipfire spread and weapon sway but heavier weight.

SHAK-12 Light Suppressor.info: A lightweight suppressor designed for the ShAK-12. Reduces sound signature and slightly reduces gun performance. Poor masking range.

BOOMBOX SD Suppressor.info:
0 stud detection radius.

Uses a cut-off handguard with an integral suppressor.
Excellent radar & sound masking while mildly lowering weapon sway and recoil but slightly reduces handling speeds.
No effects on bullet speed, mobility or damage ranges!

Muffler.info:
10% muzzle velocity lost.
No sound masking 
Cheap homemade 'suppressor' that reduces the volume of shots fired / recoil of a gun, but will still set off radars and reduce RPM by 10%.

Integral Suppressor (GOLDHAWK).info:
An integral suppressor designed for the .300 BLK SCAR SC and intended for police usage.
Increases bullet speed, penetration and damage range at the cost of hipfire spread, walk speed and handling!

AEK-919K PMS Suppressor.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A special suppressor for the AEK-919K that increases your headshot damage while mildly reducing vertical recoil and increasing range.
Reduces damage over range and mildly reduces mobility and handling.

Oil Filter (Alt).info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

LUTY Integral Suppressor.info:
150 stud detection radius.

A shoddy garage-made integral suppressor for your garage-made SMG.
Barely makes your gun quieter but mildly improves weapon sway for slightly slower handling!

VKS Suppressor.info:
The iconic big suppressor for the VKS!
Excellent sound & radar masking while also improving bullet speed and penetration at the cost of some limb kill range and worse movement and handling.

Oil Filter.info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

Remove Suppressor.info: Remove the integral suppressor off of your firearm.

Osprey Suppressor.info:
35 stud detection radius.

A light multi-caliber Western suppressor manufactured by SilencerCo for pistol caliber weaponry. Provides better hipfire accuracy, range, and exceptional masking, however aim accuracy is not affected.

PBS-1 Suppressor.info:
80 stud detection radius.

A suppressor with compensated brake ports that has a significant improvement on horizontal camera recoil while also reducing rotational and translational recoil.
Reduces mobility and handling.
Less effective at sound masking and performance range.

PORQ Chop.info: Equip your Fix with the PorQ Chop, a heavy suppressor designed for the heavy caliber. Reduced velocity, deadly quiet. Improves CQC Torso ranges. Do not eat.
